#CNT-based ADPLL 工程介绍

项目全称： 基于持续整数相位计数（CNT）的全数字锁相环（ADPLL）——整数相位保留、相干快照与短量程 TDC

文档性质： 工程介绍。面向首次接触本项目的工程师、评审者和合作者，概括项目目标、核心问题、架构、关键约束、当前进展与下一步。内容全部整理自调研包《CNT_ADPLL 调研整合与核心问题报告》（整合复核版 V1.0，2026-10-03）及其附带的逻辑检查脚本。

项目阶段： 文献证据整理、问题定义、统一相位模型与验证框架已完成；尚未进入 RTL 定版、晶体管验证或专利新颖性结论阶段。

#CNT-based ADPLL Engineering Introduction

Full project title: An all-digital phase-locked loop (ADPLL) based on a persistent integer phase counter (CNT) — integer-phase preservation, coherent snapshots, and a short-range TDC

Document nature: Engineering Introduction. It is written for engineers, reviewers and collaborators who are new to the project, and summarizes the project goals, core problems, architecture, key constraints, current progress and next steps. All content is drawn from the research package "CNT_ADPLL Research Synthesis and Core Problems Report" (consolidated review edition V1.0, 2026-10-03) and its accompanying logical-check script.

Project stage: Literature evidence consolidation, problem definition, the unified phase model and the verification framework are complete; the project has not yet reached RTL freeze, transistor-level verification, or any patent novelty conclusion.

#1 一句话定位

在 CNT / VPA / phase-domain ADPLL 中，把宽位整数相位计数器的高位降到 CKV/4 或 CKV/8 速率运行，同时不丢失任何一个原始 CKV 周期的编号；再让低位状态、参考相关快照和真正被选中的物理边沿关联起来，使有限量程 TDC 只需测量局部时间残差，并在计数进位、异步采样、选沿切换和 TDC 饱和等边界场景下，仍能得到坐标一致、可判断有效性的完整相位观测。

#1 One-Sentence Positioning

In a CNT / VPA / phase-domain ADPLL, run the high bits of the wide integer phase counter at CKV/4 or CKV/8 rate without losing the index of any raw CKV cycle; then associate the low-bit state, the reference-related snapshot and the physical edge that is actually selected, so that a finite-range TDC only has to measure the local time residue, and a complete phase observation with consistent coordinates and a judgeable validity is still obtained under boundary scenarios such as counter carry, asynchronous sampling, edge-selection switching and TDC saturation.

#2 背景与动机

传统 ADPLL（Staszewski/Bogdan 基线）用一个全速 variable phase accumulator 记录 DCO 走过的整数周期，再用 TDC 测量参考沿到 DCO 沿的小数相位。随着 DCO 频率进入数 GHz 到 20 GHz 量级，宽位计数器以全速工作的功耗、时序和布线压力都在上升。业界已有多种"高位降速"做法（/4、/8 分组计数），也有多种"物理选相 + 短 TDC"做法。

本项目要解决的不是其中某一项，而是把这两类机制接在一起，并且保证接口在所有边界条件下自洽。调研发现，公开文献分别支持各个局部环节，但尚未核实到一篇与以下完整组合严格同构的实现：

raw CKV 的 /8 高位计数 + 3-bit 原周期 residue + 该状态直接控制物理选沿 + short TDC + 完整 epoch/validity 接口

"未核实到"只描述当前证据集，不等于"没有先前技术"，也不等于拼接后的时序与因果性已经验证。

#2 Background and Motivation

A traditional ADPLL (the Staszewski/Bogdan baseline) uses a full-rate variable phase accumulator to record the integer cycles the DCO has traversed, and a TDC to measure the fractional phase from the reference edge to the DCO edge. As the DCO frequency moves into the range of several GHz to 20 GHz, the power, timing and routing pressure of a wide counter running at full rate keeps rising. The industry already has several "high-bit rate reduction" approaches (/4 and /8 split counting) and several "physical phase selection + short TDC" approaches.

What this project sets out to solve is not any single one of these, but to connect the two classes of mechanism and to guarantee that the interface is self-consistent under all boundary conditions. The survey found that the public literature supports each local piece separately, but no implementation strictly isomorphic to the following complete combination has been verified:

/8 high-bit counting of the raw CKV + 3-bit raw-cycle residue + that state directly controlling physical edge selection + short TDC + a complete epoch/validity interface

"Not verified" describes only the current evidence set; it is not the same as "there is no prior art", and it does not imply that the timing and causality of the stitched-together design have been verified.

#3 两条链：测量链与执行链

项目中有两个相互关联但不能混为一谈的任务：

链路 职责 候选实现
测量链 持续记录振荡器实际走过的周期，并在参考事件附近形成粗（coarse）细（fine）联合时间戳 分组计数器 + 相干快照 + 短 TDC
执行链 低速并行状态或预测命令如何在高速侧生成指定的物理边沿 P/S（并串转换）、one-hot、移位状态机、多相选择器

P/S 等执行器只是执行链的候选实现，不能替代 CNT 的测量功能。项目还关心：低位计数状态能否直接或经确定映射，兼任 physical-edge identity / selector 的控制信息。

#3 Two Chains: Measurement Chain and Execution Chain

The project contains two related tasks that must not be conflated:

Chain Responsibility Candidate implementations
Measurement chain Continuously record the cycles the oscillator has actually traversed, and form a joint coarse and fine timestamp near the reference event Split counter + coherent snapshot + short TDC
Execution chain How a low-rate parallel state or a predicted command generates a specified physical edge on the high-speed side P/S (parallel-to-serial), one-hot, shift state machine, multiphase selector

An executor such as P/S is only a candidate implementation of the execution chain and cannot replace the measurement function of the CNT. The project is also concerned with whether the low-bit counting state can, directly or through a deterministic mapping, double as the control information for the physical-edge identity / selector.

#4 工程目标（需求冻结）

编号 需求 验收语义
G1 持续整数相位观测 CNT 记录实际 CKV 周期，不是只在目标命中时才记录命令状态
G2 高位降速 宽位高位允许在 /4 或 /8 域工作，少量低位状态可继续高速运行
G3 原周期编号不丢失 相位模型可追溯到所选原始 CKV 节点，而非只保留慢时钟边沿
G4 粗细观测一致 coarse 与 fine 对应同一物理锚点，或携带显式、可验证的坐标变换
G5 fine 真实量程受控 目标约一个原始 CKV 周期或更小；必须按真实输入间隔检查
G6 边界与故障可辨识 wrap、采样错配、无效码、饱和、丢沿、重复沿不能静默变成有效相位
G7 P/S 不替代 CNT P/S 或 slot executor 负责物理边沿执行，不删除参考相关的 coarse 测量

#4 Engineering Goals (Requirements Freeze)

ID Requirement Acceptance semantics
G1 Continuous integer-phase observation The CNT records the actual CKV cycles, rather than recording the command state only when a target is hit
G2 High-bit rate reduction The wide high bits may run in the /4 or /8 domain, while a few low-bit states may keep running at high speed
G3 Raw-cycle index not lost The phase model can be traced back to the selected raw CKV node, rather than retaining only slow-clock edges
G4 Coarse and fine observations consistent Coarse and fine refer to the same physical anchor, or carry an explicit, verifiable coordinate transformation
G5 Real fine range under control The target is about one raw CKV cycle or less; it must be checked against the real input interval
G6 Boundaries and faults identifiable Wrap, sampling mismatch, invalid codes, saturation, dropped edges and duplicated edges must not silently turn into a valid phase
G7 P/S does not replace CNT The P/S or slot executor is responsible for physical edge execution and does not remove the reference-related coarse measurement

#5 统一相位坐标与术语

#5 Unified Phase Coordinates and Terminology

#5.1 必须先定义"数的是哪个时钟"

不同文献中的 CKV 不是同一层级的节点（Bogdan 基线的 CKV、Kuo 的多相 CKV、Zong 经过 /4·/2 预分频的 CKV 各不相同）。本项目把希望完整保留周期编号的那个时钟节点统一记作 CK0CK_0CK0​，周期 T0T_0T0​、频率 f0f_0f0​。改变 CK0CK_0CK0​ 后，CNT 权重、FCW、fine 归一化和 edge ID 必须全部换算。

符号 定义 单位/范围
CK0,T0,f0CK_0, T_0, f_0CK0​,T0​,f0​ 目标原始计数时钟及其周期、频率 s、Hz
MMM 高、低计数分组倍率 4 或 8
CCC 高位组计数（已对齐） 一个计数 = MMM 个 CK0CK_0CK0​ 周期
qqq 组内原周期 residue 0…M−10 \ldots M-10…M−1；不是 TDC 小数码
NNN 原周期整数编号 N=MC+qN = MC + qN=MC+q
JJJ 某个实际原始上升沿的绝对编号 原周期
α\alphaα 选中边沿相对该上升沿的周期内偏移 原周期
μ\muμ 参考至被选边沿的有符号相位间隔 原周期
TdT_dTd​ 分组慢时钟周期 Td=MT0T_d = M T_0Td​=MT0​

#5.1 First define "which clock is being counted"

The CKV in different publications is not a node at the same level (the CKV of the Bogdan baseline, the multiphase CKV of Kuo, and the CKV of Zong after /4·/2 prescaling are all different). This project uniformly denotes the clock node whose cycle index is to be fully preserved as CK0CK_0CK0​, with period T0T_0T0​ and frequency f0f_0f0​. After CK0CK_0CK0​ is changed, the CNT weights, FCW, fine normalization and edge IDs must all be converted.

Symbol Definition Unit / range
CK0,T0,f0CK_0, T_0, f_0CK0​,T0​,f0​ Target raw counting clock and its period and frequency s, Hz
MMM High/low counting group ratio 4 or 8
CCC High-bit group count (aligned) One count = MMM CK0CK_0CK0​ cycles
qqq In-group raw-cycle residue 0…M−10 \ldots M-10…M−1; not the TDC fractional code
NNN Raw-cycle integer index N=MC+qN = MC + qN=MC+q
JJJ Absolute index of an actual raw rising edge Raw cycles
α\alphaα Intra-cycle offset of the selected edge relative to that rising edge Raw cycles
μ\muμ Signed phase interval from the reference to the selected edge Raw cycles
TdT_dTd​ Period of the grouped slow clock Td=MT0T_d = M T_0Td​=MT0​

#5.2 核心公式

整数分解（定义，不是 CDC 正确性证明）：

N=MC+q,(C,M−1)→(C+1,0)N = MC + q,\qquad (C, M-1) \rightarrow (C+1, 0)N=MC+q,(C,M−1)→(C+1,0)

完整相位表达（锚点减残差）：

Ak=Jk+αk,Φ0(tR,k)=Ak−μk,μk=∫tR,ktE,kf0(t) dtA_k = J_k + \alpha_k,\qquad \Phi_0(t_{R,k}) = A_k - \mu_k,\qquad \mu_k = \int_{t_{R,k}}^{t_{E,k}} f_0(t)\,dtAk​=Jk​+αk​,Φ0​(tR,k​)=Ak​−μk​,μk​=∫tR,k​tE,k​​f0​(t)dt

μ\muμ 的符号由积分上下限决定，preceding edge 和 following edge 共用同一公式。只有在局部频率近似恒定时才可用 μ^≈Δt^/T^0\hat\mu \approx \widehat{\Delta t} / \hat T_0μ^​≈Δt/T^0​ 归一化；过长的 selected-edge 间隔不宜仅靠固定周期归一化。

#5.2 Core formulas

Integer decomposition (a definition, not a proof of CDC correctness):

N=MC+q,(C,M−1)→(C+1,0)N = MC + q,\qquad (C, M-1) \rightarrow (C+1, 0)N=MC+q,(C,M−1)→(C+1,0)

Complete phase expression (anchor minus residual):

Ak=Jk+αk,Φ0(tR,k)=Ak−μk,μk=∫tR,ktE,kf0(t) dtA_k = J_k + \alpha_k,\qquad \Phi_0(t_{R,k}) = A_k - \mu_k,\qquad \mu_k = \int_{t_{R,k}}^{t_{E,k}} f_0(t)\,dtAk​=Jk​+αk​,Φ0​(tR,k​)=Ak​−μk​,μk​=∫tR,k​tE,k​​f0​(t)dt

The sign of μ\muμ is determined by the integration limits, and the preceding edge and the following edge share the same formula. Only when the local frequency is approximately constant may one normalize with μ^≈Δt^/T^0\hat\mu \approx \widehat{\Delta t} / \hat T_0μ^​≈Δt/T^0​; an overly long selected-edge interval should not be normalized by a fixed period alone.

#5.3 三条已被纠正的表述

  1. 不能通用地写 8C+q+e/8+ϵ8C + q + e/8 + \epsilon8C+q+e/8+ϵ。 qqq 与多相区域码 eee 可能重复表示同一相位区间，且 e/8e/8e/8 的单位可能是分频后周期而非原周期。改为"锚点减残差"。
  2. 不能把所有 epoch 错配都归为 ±1 原周期。 高低位在组边界撕裂采样时，典型错误是 −M-M−M 与 +M+M+M（一整组），与 raw-CKV 错一周期是不同故障。
  3. Sony 专利不是共享状态方法的最早先例。 Havens（US8692598B2）已同时包含整数计数、小数检测、sub-fractional TDC 和利用小数状态消除 one-count uncertainty。

#5.3 Three statements that have been corrected

  1. One cannot write 8C+q+e/8+ϵ8C + q + e/8 + \epsilon8C+q+e/8+ϵ generically. qqq and the multiphase region code eee may represent the same phase interval redundantly, and the unit of e/8e/8e/8 may be the divided-clock period rather than the raw cycle. This is replaced by "anchor minus residual".
  2. Not all epoch mismatches can be attributed to ±1 raw cycle. When the high and low bits are sampled torn at a group boundary, the typical errors are −M-M−M and +M+M+M (one whole group), which is a different fault from a one-cycle error of the raw CKV.
  3. The Sony patent is not the earliest precedent of the shared-state method. Havens (US8692598B2) already contains integer counting, fractional detection, a sub-fractional TDC, and the use of the fractional state to eliminate one-count uncertainty.

#6 系统架构

下图是报告给出的功能数据流综合（不是任何原图的重绘）：

实际 CK0 → 持续高/低计数状态 → REF 相关安全快照 → coarse anchor
                     │
计划 J_plan → 高位命中 + slot 控制 → 物理选沿/门控 → 实际边沿
                                                       │
                                            执行侧观察 J_observed
                                                       │
REF → 局部 fine 测量 ← 被选真实边沿 ──────────────────────┘
                     │
             元组一致性 + VALID/SAT + 坐标重建 → phase error

模块职责：

  • 持续计数器（CNT）： 低 log⁡2M\log_2 Mlog2​M 位以 CK0CK_0CK0​ 速率保存状态（可以是二进制、Johnson/Gray、shift state 等），高位在 TdT_dTd​ 域累加。高位时钟必须与低位 wrap 在逻辑上同源，不能是任意同频 /M 时钟。
  • 相干快照： 在参考事件附近捕获 {C,q}\{C, q\}{C,q} 及边界侧信息。"相干"的本质是同一逻辑 epoch，不要求所有位物理上同一时刻锁存。
  • 执行器（P/S / slot executor）： 目标边沿 Jplan=MHJ+sJJ_{plan} = M H_J + s_JJplan​=MHJ​+sJ​，慢速域做高位匹配和未来计划，高速少量状态做 slot enable、脉冲形成和根时钟重定时。
  • 执行回执： 独立产生 JobservedJ_{observed}Jobserved​，不能由 JplanJ_{plan}Jplan​ 延迟几拍改名得到。
  • 短 TDC： 只测参考沿与被选真实物理边沿之间的局部残差，携带 SAT/VALID。
  • 相位整合： 校验元组一致性，输出 FINE / COARSE / INVALID 三态之一及误差上界。

#6 System Architecture

The figure below is the functional data-flow synthesis given in the report (it is not a redrawing of any original figure):

Actual CK0 → continuous high/low count state → REF-related safe snapshot → coarse anchor
                     │
Plan J_plan → high-bit match + slot control → physical edge selection/gating → actual edge
                                                       │
                                            execution side observes J_observed
                                                       │
REF → local fine measurement ← selected real edge ──────────────────────┘
                     │
             tuple consistency + VALID/SAT + coordinate reconstruction → phase error

Module responsibilities:

  • Continuous counter (CNT): The low log⁡2M\log_2 Mlog2​M bits hold the state at the CK0CK_0CK0​ rate (which may be binary, Johnson/Gray, shift state, etc.), and the high bits accumulate in the TdT_dTd​ domain. The high-bit clock must be logically derived from the same source as the low-bit wrap, and cannot be an arbitrary same-frequency /M clock.
  • Coherent snapshot: Captures {C,q}\{C, q\}{C,q} and boundary-side information near the reference event. The essence of "coherent" is the same logical epoch; it does not require all bits to be latched at physically the same instant.
  • Executor (P/S / slot executor): The target edge is Jplan=MHJ+sJJ_{plan} = M H_J + s_JJplan​=MHJ​+sJ​; the slow domain performs the high-bit match and future planning, and the few high-speed states perform slot enable, pulse formation and root-clock retiming.
  • Execution receipt: Independently produces JobservedJ_{observed}Jobserved​; it cannot be obtained by delaying JplanJ_{plan}Jplan​ by a few cycles and renaming it.
  • Short TDC: Measures only the local residue between the reference edge and the selected real physical edge, and carries SAT/VALID.
  • Phase integration: Checks tuple consistency and outputs one of the three states FINE / COARSE / INVALID together with an error bound.

#7 四大核心难点

#7 Four Core Difficulties

#7.1 epoch 错误必须按层级分类

以 M=8M=8M=8、旧状态 C=10,q=7C=10, q=7C=10,q=7 跨组为例：

状态 CCC qqq 8C+q8C+q8C+q 含义
跨组前 10 7 87 合法旧状态
跨组后 11 0 88 合法新状态
旧高位 + 新低位 10 0 80 相对 88 错 −8
新高位 + 旧低位 11 7 95 相对 87 错 +8

结论：

  • 修正接口必须分单位：Ncorr=M(Ccap+κC)+qcorr+κNN_{corr} = M(C_{cap} + \kappa_C) + q_{corr} + \kappa_NNcorr​=M(Ccap​+κC​)+qcorr​+κN​，κC\kappa_CκC​ 以组为单位、κN\kappa_NκN​ 以原周期为单位；κC∈{−1,0,+1}\kappa_C \in \{-1, 0, +1\}κC​∈{−1,0,+1} 只在采样延迟已证明最多跨一组时成立。
  • 低位盲区： (N+M) mod M=N mod M(N+M) \bmod M = N \bmod M(N+M)modM=NmodM 且 (N+M) mod 2=N mod 2(N+M) \bmod 2 = N \bmod 2(N+M)mod2=Nmod2。整组错误既不改变 qqq 也不改变原周期奇偶性，因此直接搬用 Havens/Sony 的 low-bit XOR 未必能检测高位错组，需要额外保留跨组翻转的状态（高位 LSB 独立观测、wrap toggle 等）。
  • 边界允许两种坐标： J−μ=(J+1)−(μ+1)J - \mu = (J+1) - (\mu+1)J−μ=(J+1)−(μ+1)。coarse 与 fine 必须共同变换，不能一条链选 J+1J+1J+1、另一条链仍相对 JJJ。
  • 亚稳态是模拟风险，Gray/Johnson 编码只约束数字码相邻性，不消除亚稳态。验收分两层：数字模型证明无静默错码；晶体管/PVT 模型评估剩余失效率。

#7.1 Epoch errors must be classified by level

Take M=8M=8M=8 and an old state C=10,q=7C=10, q=7C=10,q=7 crossing a group boundary as an example:

State CCC qqq 8C+q8C+q8C+q Meaning
Before crossing 10 7 87 Legal old state
After crossing 11 0 88 Legal new state
Old high + new low 10 0 80 −8 relative to 88
New high + old low 11 7 95 +8 relative to 87

Conclusions:

  • The correction interface must separate units: Ncorr=M(Ccap+κC)+qcorr+κNN_{corr} = M(C_{cap} + \kappa_C) + q_{corr} + \kappa_NNcorr​=M(Ccap​+κC​)+qcorr​+κN​, where κC\kappa_CκC​ is in groups and κN\kappa_NκN​ is in raw cycles; κC∈{−1,0,+1}\kappa_C \in \{-1, 0, +1\}κC​∈{−1,0,+1} holds only when the sampling delay has been proven to span at most one group.
  • Low-bit blind spot: (N+M) mod M=N mod M(N+M) \bmod M = N \bmod M(N+M)modM=NmodM and (N+M) mod 2=N mod 2(N+M) \bmod 2 = N \bmod 2(N+M)mod2=Nmod2. A whole-group error changes neither qqq nor the raw-cycle parity, so directly reusing the low-bit XOR of Havens/Sony may not detect a high-bit group error; extra state that retains the group-crossing toggle is needed (an independent observation of the high-bit LSB, a wrap toggle, etc.).
  • The boundary admits two coordinates: J−μ=(J+1)−(μ+1)J - \mu = (J+1) - (\mu+1)J−μ=(J+1)−(μ+1). Coarse and fine must be transformed together; one chain must not choose J+1J+1J+1 while the other is still relative to JJJ.
  • Metastability is an analog risk; Gray/Johnson encoding only constrains digital code adjacency and does not eliminate metastability. Acceptance has two layers: the digital model proves there is no silent wrong code; the transistor/PVT model evaluates the residual failure rate.

#7.2 snapshot 的三条实现路线

路线 思路 文献依据 仍须独立证明
A 多候选捕获 rising/falling 或多相生成多个重定时候选，按边界侧信息选安全候选 TI、Kuo、Havens、Marvell select 稳定、元组原子选择
B 匹配延迟采样 各计数组按传播延迟 [dmin,dmax][d^{min}, d^{max}][dmin,dmax] 错开采样时刻，再统一重采样 CN105071798、Zong Fig.9 PVT min/max、所有组属同一 epoch
C 有界错配 + 冗余校正 允许已知类型的 capture ambiguity，从冗余状态识别修正 Havens、Sony 故障集合覆盖、修正单位、歧义时 INVALID

路线 B 的时序约束：

tS,imin≥tE+dimax+tsu,i,tS,imax+th,i≤tnext,i+dnext,imint_{S,i}^{min} \ge t_E + d_i^{max} + t_{su,i},\qquad t_{S,i}^{max} + t_{h,i} \le t_{next,i} + d_{next,i}^{min}tS,imin​≥tE​+dimax​+tsu,i​,tS,imax​+th,i​≤tnext,i​+dnext,imin​

验收条件为每组余量 mi>0,hi>0m_i > 0, h_i > 0mi​>0,hi​>0 且所有组属于同一 epoch。三条路线可以组合，但组合后必须重新检查联合状态空间。建议以候选元组 {coarse, low_state, boundary_side, fine_anchor_id, candidate_id} 为原子选择单位。

#7.2 Three implementation routes for the snapshot

Route Idea Literature basis Still to be proven independently
A Multi-candidate capture Rising/falling or multiphase edges generate several retimed candidates, and a safe candidate is chosen by boundary-side information TI, Kuo, Havens, Marvell Select stability, atomic tuple selection
B Matched-delay sampling Each counter group is sampled at staggered times according to its propagation delay [dmin,dmax][d^{min}, d^{max}][dmin,dmax], then resampled uniformly CN105071798, Zong Fig.9 PVT min/max, all groups belong to the same epoch
C Bounded mismatch + redundant correction Allows capture ambiguity of known types, and identifies the correction from redundant state Havens, Sony Fault-set coverage, correction units, INVALID on ambiguity

Timing constraints of Route B:

tS,imin≥tE+dimax+tsu,i,tS,imax+th,i≤tnext,i+dnext,imint_{S,i}^{min} \ge t_E + d_i^{max} + t_{su,i},\qquad t_{S,i}^{max} + t_{h,i} \le t_{next,i} + d_{next,i}^{min}tS,imin​≥tE​+dimax​+tsu,i​,tS,imax​+th,i​≤tnext,i​+dnext,imin​

The acceptance condition is that every group has margins mi>0,hi>0m_i > 0, h_i > 0mi​>0,hi​>0 and that all groups belong to the same epoch. The three routes can be combined, but after combination the joint state space must be re-checked. It is recommended to take the candidate tuple {coarse, low_state, boundary_side, fine_anchor_id, candidate_id} as the unit of atomic selection.

#7.3 P/S 与物理边沿执行的因果性

  • 计划不是执行证据。 错沿、丢沿、重复沿和 gate control 晚到可能完全不改变数字计划，必须由真实执行路径产生 JobservedJ_{observed}Jobserved​。
  • 后知后觉的低速 snapshot 不能生成已经过去的边沿。 REF 到来后经快照、CDC、解码、低速计算再控制 selector，附近的 CKV 沿可能早已过去。只有三类路径能闭合：事先预测并在目标前提交选择；高速前端并行捕获候选后慢速解码；选用未来可执行边沿并接受其量程代价。
  • 选沿 deadline： tarrive+tsetup,exec+tguard≤ttargett_{arrive} + t_{setup,exec} + t_{guard} \le t_{target}tarrive​+tsetup,exec​+tguard​≤ttarget​。不满足时必须显式 LATE/MISS 或重新规划不同的 JJJ，任何补发都要改变回执和相位坐标。
  • MASH future-edge planning 属于扩展层，只在上述接口上提供目标序列，不是基础测量问题的一部分。

#7.3 Causality of P/S and physical edge execution

  • A plan is not execution evidence. A wrong edge, a dropped edge, a duplicated edge and a late gate control may leave the digital plan completely unchanged, so JobservedJ_{observed}Jobserved​ must be produced by the real execution path.
  • An after-the-fact low-rate snapshot cannot generate an edge that has already passed. After REF arrives, passing through the snapshot, CDC, decoding and low-rate computation before controlling the selector, the nearby CKV edge may already be long gone. Only three kinds of path can close: predict in advance and commit the selection before the target; capture candidates in parallel in a high-speed front end and decode them slowly afterwards; or choose a future edge that can still be executed and accept its range cost.
  • Edge-selection deadline: tarrive+tsetup,exec+tguard≤ttargett_{arrive} + t_{setup,exec} + t_{guard} \le t_{target}tarrive​+tsetup,exec​+tguard​≤ttarget​. When it is not satisfied, LATE/MISS must be raised explicitly, or a different JJJ must be re-planned; any re-issue must change the receipt and the phase coordinate.
  • MASH future-edge planning belongs to the extension layer; it only provides the target sequence on top of the interface above and is not part of the basic measurement problem.

#7.4 fine 的真实量程、饱和与校准

  • CNT 可以表示多周期差，但不改变 TDC 两个输入端已经存在的物理时间间隔。饱和函数 Q(x)Q(x)Q(x) 对 x≥Rx \ge Rx≥R 输出相同值，事后数字减整周期无法恢复已压缩的信息。"数字可以做 modulo"不等于"模拟 TDC 可以缩到一个周期"。
  • 路径延迟统一按 Δt^=d^pin−(τ^E−τ^R)\widehat{\Delta t} = \hat d_{pin} - (\hat\tau_E - \hat\tau_R)Δt=d^pin​−(τ^E​−τ^R​) 处理；DTC 放在参考路径计入 τR\tau_RτR​，放在反馈路径计入 τE\tau_EτE​，不得重复补偿。
  • fine 采用条件：Fusable=Vcode∧Vrange∧Vanchor∧Vepoch∧VcalF_{usable} = V_{code} \land V_{range} \land V_{anchor} \land V_{epoch} \land V_{cal}Fusable​=Vcode​∧Vrange​∧Vanchor​∧Vepoch​∧Vcal​。range_ok 必须来自电路可实现的饱和/溢出检查，不是仿真器里的理想相位。
  • fine 无效时可用 coarse 相位误差 ec[k]=R[k]−NR[k]e_c[k] = R[k] - N_R[k]ec​[k]=R[k]−NR​[k] 接管。CNT 本身不自动构成 FLL；只有另行设计频率误差控制器时才称 FLL-assisted。
  • 数值示例（理想计算，非芯片指标）：f0=8f_0 = 8f0​=8 GHz 时 T0=125T_0 = 125T0​=125 ps，/4 后周期 500 ps，均匀八相间距 62.5 ps。TDC 量程必须由实际测量流程推导，不能因为"有八相"就直接写 ±31.25 ps。

#7.4 Real fine range, saturation and calibration

  • The CNT can represent multi-cycle differences, but it does not change the physical time interval already present at the two inputs of the TDC. The saturation function Q(x)Q(x)Q(x) outputs the same value for x≥Rx \ge Rx≥R, and subtracting whole cycles digitally afterwards cannot recover the information already compressed. "Digital can do modulo" is not the same as "the analog TDC can be shrunk to one cycle".
  • Path delay is handled uniformly as Δt^=d^pin−(τ^E−τ^R)\widehat{\Delta t} = \hat d_{pin} - (\hat\tau_E - \hat\tau_R)Δt=d^pin​−(τ^E​−τ^R​); a DTC placed in the reference path is counted in τR\tau_RτR​, and in the feedback path in τE\tau_EτE​, and it must not be compensated twice.
  • Fine usability condition: Fusable=Vcode∧Vrange∧Vanchor∧Vepoch∧VcalF_{usable} = V_{code} \land V_{range} \land V_{anchor} \land V_{epoch} \land V_{cal}Fusable​=Vcode​∧Vrange​∧Vanchor​∧Vepoch​∧Vcal​. range_ok must come from a circuit-realizable saturation/overflow check, not from the ideal phase in a simulator.
  • When fine is invalid, the coarse phase error ec[k]=R[k]−NR[k]e_c[k] = R[k] - N_R[k]ec​[k]=R[k]−NR​[k] can take over. The CNT by itself does not automatically constitute an FLL; only when a frequency-error controller is separately designed can it be called FLL-assisted.
  • Numerical example (ideal calculation, not a chip specification): at f0=8f_0 = 8f0​=8 GHz, T0=125T_0 = 125T0​=125 ps, the period after /4 is 500 ps, and the uniform eight-phase spacing is 62.5 ps. The TDC range must be derived from the actual measurement flow, and one cannot write ±31.25 ps directly just because "there are eight phases".

编号 不变量 违反后的处理
I1 实际 CK0CK_0CK0​ 周期连续，N=MC+qN = MC + qN=MC+q 的原点与 carry 一致 阻断有效相位；检查复位/极性/计数实现

#8.2 Eight invariants

ID Invariant Handling on violation
I1 The actual CK0CK_0CK0​ cycles are continuous, and the origin of N=MC+qN = MC + qN=MC+q is consistent with the carry Block the valid phase; check reset/polarity/counter implementation
I2 Coarse and fine share the same anchor, or the anchor transformation is recorded explicitly Correct, or INVALID; never add them silently
I3 The unit of the correction and the set of errors it covers are explicit Mark invalid when out of bounds; do not truncate to ±1
I4 JobservedJ_{observed}Jobserved​ reflects real execution and is not self-certified by JplanJ_{plan}Jplan​ Mark the receipt as unverified; it does not enter fine_valid
I5 Fine range, code legality and calibration are all satisfied Downgrade to coarse/interval/invalid
I6 The two boundary candidates are equivalent in the common coordinate An inconsistency is treated as a stitching error
I7 The low-speed computation meets the edge-selection deadline late/miss, or re-plan and update JJJ
I8 The full-counter rollover uses an explicit modular-arithmetic window Reset/reacquire when beyond the unwrappable range

#8.3 相位整合伪代码

on complete_event(frame):
    check_clock_node_and_reset_epoch(frame)
    coarse = decode_and_align_coarse(frame)
    observed = verify_physical_edge_identity(frame)

    if coarse.valid and observed.valid and fine_is_usable(frame):
        anchor = observed.J + frame.alpha_sel
        mu = normalize_fine_with_matching_calibration(frame)
        phase = anchor - mu
        return FINE, phase, fine_error_bound

    if coarse.valid:
        return COARSE, coarse.phase_estimate, coarse.error_bound

    return INVALID, no_new_measurement

控制层必须对 COARSE / INVALID 有单独、可验证的状态处理；测量有效性与控制器故障恢复不是同一问题。

#8.3 Phase-integration pseudo-code

on complete_event(frame):
    check_clock_node_and_reset_epoch(frame)
    coarse = decode_and_align_coarse(frame)
    observed = verify_physical_edge_identity(frame)

    if coarse.valid and observed.valid and fine_is_usable(frame):
        anchor = observed.J + frame.alpha_sel
        mu = normalize_fine_with_matching_calibration(frame)
        phase = anchor - mu
        return FINE, phase, fine_error_bound

    if coarse.valid:
        return COARSE, coarse.phase_estimate, coarse.error_bound

    return INVALID, no_new_measurement

The control layer must have separate, verifiable state handling for COARSE / INVALID; measurement validity and controller fault recovery are not the same problem.

#9.3 几个必须记住的单位陷阱

  • Kuo 2018 的 DCO 范围是 5.7–8.4 GHz，"约 2 GHz"是 /4 后的节点；八相间距折算到前置 /4 之前的 T0T_0T0​ 是 T0/2T_0/2T0​/2，不是 T0/8T_0/8T0​/8。
  • Zong 2019 的 counter 基准是约 20 GHz 基波经 /8 后的 CKV，不能把其低两位当作 20 GHz 全部周期的低两位。
  • TI 的 CKVD8 不能只看信号名就默认其某个有效沿等于 carry；普通二进制 q[2]q[2]q[2] 的上升沿对应 3→4，下降沿对应 7→0。

#9.3 A few unit traps that must be remembered

  • The DCO range in Kuo 2018 is 5.7–8.4 GHz, and "about 2 GHz" is the node after /4; the eight-phase spacing converted to the T0T_0T0​ before the preceding /4 is T0/2T_0/2T0​/2, not T0/8T_0/8T0​/8.
  • The counter reference of Zong 2019 is the CKV obtained from the roughly 20 GHz fundamental after /8; its low two bits cannot be treated as the low two bits of all 20 GHz cycles.
  • For the CKVD8 of TI, one cannot assume merely from the signal name that some active edge of it equals the carry; the rising edge of the ordinary binary q[2]q[2]q[2] corresponds to 3→4, and the falling edge corresponds to 7→0.

#10.2 Main revisions relative to previous rounds

"/8 makes the fine TDC necessarily see 8 raw cycles, which the snapshot then compresses back" Does not hold; counter rate reduction, TDC input prescaling and physical edge selection are three different things
"Sony was the first to find the same state participating in both integer and fractional" Tightened; Havens is a precedent
"Uniformly adopt κ = −1/0/+1" Changed to a correction with units and a fault set
"8C+q+e/8+ϵ8C+q+e/8+\epsilon8C+q+e/8+ϵ can serve as a general phase formula" Withdrawn; replaced by anchor minus residual
"Coherent must equal simultaneous latching" The logical coherence definition is retained; matched-delay readout can obtain the same epoch at different times
"Digital integer cancellation can remove the CNT" Explicitly not possible; the CNT remains the basis of real coarse observation and receipt verification
"A generic PISO is a direct precedent of the CNT-ADPLL" Downgrade maintained; it can only demonstrate an executor primitive

The main lines — the /4-/8 split, the persistent CNT, boundary correction, the short TDC, the selected-edge coordinate, SAT/VALID and the execution receipt — are all retained.

#11 验证计划（三层 + 闭环）

  1. 事件级 golden model。 从原始真实边沿时间驱动持久 CNT，分别模拟采样、执行和有限 TDC。禁止把理想 Φ0(tR)\Phi_0(t_R)Φ0​(tR​) 直接喂给 decoder。覆盖 /4、/8 全部 residue、跨组与全宽 rollover、rising/falling 候选切换、不同传播延迟、fine 正负量程与饱和、选择码晚到、丢沿/重复沿、复位相位、校准版本错配。逐事件比较 JobservedJ_{observed}Jobserved​、coarse anchor、最终 phase 与 ground truth。
  2. RTL/门级时序验证。 重点：carry 极性、shift-state decode、候选元组选择、snapshot 生命周期、异步同步延迟、load/shift ownership、短脉冲、门控 latch、根时钟 retiming。每类异步路径给出明确 STA/CDC 约束，不简单全部 false-path。
  3. 晶体管/PVT 验证。 补齐数字模型无法证明的部分：亚稳态解析时间、validity/selection 的亚稳传播、非法码、delay-matching 失配、占空比、mux/gate 毛刺、窄脉冲、TDC 饱和判定、回执电路扰动。第 7.2 节的参数化约束要转为实际电路的 min/max 表。
  4. 闭环验证不能替代局部正确性。 顺序为：事件身份正确 → 有效性完整 → 局部时序通过 → 再比较噪声、spur、锁定与恢复时间。记录相位误差峰值与分布、fine 直方图、SAT 占比、修正触发分布、无效观测连续长度、edge mismatch 次数和模式切换的相位不连续。

#11 Verification Plan (Three Layers + Closed Loop)

  1. Event-level golden model. Drive the persistent CNT from raw real edge times, and simulate sampling, execution and the finite TDC separately. Feeding the ideal Φ0(tR)\Phi_0(t_R)Φ0​(tR​) directly to the decoder is forbidden. Coverage: all residues for /4 and /8, group crossing and full-width rollover, rising/falling candidate switching, different propagation delays, positive and negative fine range and saturation, late selection codes, dropped/duplicated edges, reset phase, and calibration-version mismatch. Compare JobservedJ_{observed}Jobserved​, the coarse anchor, the final phase and the ground truth event by event.
  2. RTL/gate-level timing verification. Focus on: carry polarity, shift-state decode, candidate tuple selection, snapshot lifetime, asynchronous synchronization delay, load/shift ownership, short pulses, gating latches, and root-clock retiming. Give explicit STA/CDC constraints for each class of asynchronous path, rather than simply declaring all of them false paths.
  3. Transistor/PVT verification. Fill in what the digital model cannot prove: metastability resolution time, metastable propagation of validity/selection, illegal codes, delay-matching mismatch, duty cycle, mux/gate glitches, narrow pulses, the TDC saturation decision, and receipt-circuit perturbation. The parameterized constraints of Section 7.2 are to be turned into min/max tables for the actual circuit.
  4. Closed-loop verification cannot replace local correctness. The order is: event identity correct → validity complete → local timing passes → only then compare noise, spurs, lock and recovery time. Record the peak and distribution of the phase error, the fine histogram, the SAT fraction, the distribution of correction triggers, the consecutive length of invalid observations, the number of edge mismatches, and the phase discontinuity at mode switches.

#12 未闭合问题与下一步

#12 Open Problems and Next Steps

#12.1 必须先回答的五个工程问题

问题 必须形成的产物 完成判据
Q1 以哪个节点作为原周期？ clock-node 表与全部倍率/相位原点 CNT、FCW、TDC、DTC、edge ID 同一量纲
Q2 C/q 在边界如何关联？ 全 residue、wrap、候选切换真值表 每个允许状态都对应合法锚点或 INVALID
Q3 低位如何控制真实选沿？ raw-state → slot → physical-edge 映射及 deadline 不能生成过去边沿；late/miss 行为确定
Q4 谁证明实际边沿编号？ JobservedJ_{observed}Jobserved​ 电路与独立校验路径 计划错误/丢沿注入后不会自证通过
Q5 short TDC 何时可信？ 物理量程预算、SAT/VALID、校准/降级规范 饱和码不作为精确 fine，coarse 仍可解释

#12.1 Five engineering questions that must be answered first

Question Deliverable that must be produced Completion criterion
Q1 Which node is taken as the raw cycle? Clock-node table and all ratios/phase origins CNT, FCW, TDC, DTC and edge ID share the same dimension
Q2 How are C/q associated at the boundary? Truth table of all residues, wrap and candidate switching Every allowed state corresponds to a legal anchor or INVALID
Q3 How does the low part control the real edge selection? raw-state → slot → physical-edge mapping and the deadline Cannot generate a past edge; late/miss behavior is deterministic
Q4 Who proves the actual edge index? JobservedJ_{observed}Jobserved​ circuit and an independent verification path Does not self-certify after plan-error/dropped-edge injection
Q5 When can the short TDC be trusted? Physical range budget, SAT/VALID, calibration/downgrade specification A saturated code is not used as an exact fine value, and coarse remains interpretable

#12.2 收敛顺序

  1. 完成 TI / Xu / ETRI 的 carry、极性和解码关系核对。
  2. 把 Havens/Sony 的冗余状态迁移为带明确错误集合的 /4-/8 epoch 表。
  3. 检查 Kuo/MediaTek 的物理选相是否满足本项目执行因果性，而不只是"同样有一个 MUX"。
  4. 最后再接 MASH、DTC/QNC、REF X2 等扩展，并保留原始基线回归。

待补证的历史线索：Jiang 2011 MSc、Yin 2013 PhD、Bogdan/Balsara 2006 原书对应页，以及 H. Liu JSSC 2025 的 counter/feedback-generator 内部图。

#12.2 Convergence order

  1. Complete the cross-check of the carry, polarity and decoding relations of TI / Xu / ETRI.
  2. Migrate the redundant state of Havens/Sony into a /4-/8 epoch table with explicit error sets.
  3. Check whether the physical phase selection of Kuo/MediaTek satisfies this project's execution causality, rather than merely "also having a MUX".
  4. Only at the end attach extensions such as MASH, DTC/QNC and REF X2, while retaining a regression against the original baseline.

Historical leads still to be substantiated: Jiang 2011 MSc, Yin 2013 PhD, the corresponding pages of the original Bogdan/Balsara 2006 book, and the internal counter/feedback-generator figures of H. Liu JSSC 2025.

#12.3 关于差异点的表述

"低位状态同时服务整数与小数"已有公开披露，不能作为差异点概括。更具体的研究对象是：原周期 residue 的映射、实际选沿回执、block/raw-cycle 两级修正、有限 TDC 的有效性及恢复协议。是否构成可保护的差异需另行对照权利要求，本项目目前不给出新颖性、侵权或可授权结论。

#12.3 On how the points of difference are stated

"The low-bit state serving both integer and fractional" has already been publicly disclosed and cannot be summarized as a point of difference. The more specific research objects are: the mapping of the raw-cycle residue, the actual edge-selection receipt, two-level block/raw-cycle correction, and the validity and recovery protocol of the finite TDC. Whether this constitutes a protectable difference requires a separate comparison against the claims; this project currently gives no conclusion on novelty, infringement or patentability.

#CNT-based ADPLL：整数相位保留、相干快照与短量程 TDC

CKV/4、CKV/8、共享状态与物理选沿的多轮调研整合报告

整合复核版 V1.0 · 2026-10-03

报告定位： 文献证据整理、核心问题定义、统一相位模型与验证框架。不是已完成晶体管验证的电路定版，也不是专利新颖性结论。

覆盖材料： 2026-09-27 与 2026-09-28 两份既有调研报告、当前对话新增的 TI / ETRI / Sony 等线索，以及本次可取得的公开原文。历史报告已经读取；未取得全部历史对话逐字记录，因此本文不充当原始问答存档。

阅读路线： 第 1–3 章说明问题与坐标；第 4–5 章给出文献证据及其边界；第 6–10 章展开时序、物理选沿与接口；第 11–13 章记录修订、验证和未解决项；第 14 章及附录提供引用入口和原图定位。

#CNT-based ADPLL: Integer-Phase Preservation, Coherent Snapshots and Short-Range TDC

A Multi-Round Research Synthesis Report on CKV/4, CKV/8, Shared State and Physical Edge Selection

Consolidated Review Edition V1.0 · 2026-10-03

Positioning of this report: an organization of the literature evidence, a definition of the core problem, a unified phase model and a verification framework. It is not a circuit freeze that has completed transistor-level verification, nor is it a patent-novelty conclusion.

Materials covered: the two existing research reports of 2026-09-27 and 2026-09-28, the TI / ETRI / Sony and other leads newly added in the current conversation, and the public original texts that could be obtained in this round. The historical reports have been read; verbatim transcripts of all historical conversations were not obtained, so this document does not serve as an archive of the original questions and answers.

Reading route: Chapters 1–3 explain the problem and the coordinates; Chapters 4–5 present the literature evidence and its boundaries; Chapters 6–10 develop timing, physical edge selection and interfaces; Chapters 11–13 record revisions, verification and open items; Chapter 14 and the appendices provide citation entry points and the locations of the original figures.

#1 核心问题与结论摘要

#1 Core Problem and Summary of Conclusions

#1.1 核心问题的正式表述

在 CNT / VPA / phase-domain ADPLL 中，能否将宽位整数相位计数器的高位降至 CKV/4 或 CKV/8 工作，同时完整保留原始 CKV 周期编号；再把低位状态、参考相关快照和被选择的真实物理边沿关联起来，使有限量程 TDC 只测局部时间残差，并在计数进位、异步采样、选沿切换和 TDC 饱和时，仍得到坐标一致、可判断有效性的完整相位观测？

这里有两个相互关联、但不能混为一谈的任务。第一是测量链：持续记录振荡器实际走过的周期，并在参考事件附近形成粗细联合时间戳。第二是执行链：低速并行状态或预测命令如何在高速侧生成指定的物理边沿。P/S、one-hot、移位状态机和多相选择器只是执行链的候选实现，不等于整个测量问题已经解决。

本项目进一步关心：低位计数状态能否直接或经确定映射，兼任 physical-edge identity / selector 的控制信息。目标不是另找一个普通小数分频器，而是保留 CNT-based ADPLL 的持续整数相位观测。

#1.1 Formal Statement of the Core Problem

In a CNT / VPA / phase-domain ADPLL, can the high bits of a wide integer phase counter be lowered to operate at CKV/4 or CKV/8 while the raw CKV cycle index is fully preserved; and can the low-bit state, the reference-related snapshot and the selected true physical edge then be associated with one another, so that a finite-range TDC measures only the local time residual, and so that a complete phase observation that is coordinate-consistent and whose validity can be judged is still obtained under counter carries, asynchronous sampling, edge-selection switching and TDC saturation?

There are two interrelated tasks here that must not be conflated. The first is the measurement chain: continuously recording the cycles the oscillator has actually traversed, and forming a joint coarse/fine timestamp near the reference event. The second is the execution chain: how low-speed parallel state or predicted commands generate a designated physical edge on the high-speed side. P/S, one-hot, shift-state machines and multiphase selectors are only candidate implementations of the execution chain; they are not the same as having solved the whole measurement problem.

This project is further concerned with whether the low-bit count state can, directly or through a deterministic mapping, double as the control information for the physical-edge identity / selector. The goal is not to find yet another ordinary fractional divider, but to preserve the continuous integer phase observation of the CNT-based ADPLL.

#1.2 已有证据足以支持什么

宽位计数器可以拆分降速。 TI 的 /8 实施例、Xu/Lindfors 的 /4 相位累加器，以及 ETRI 的 /4 计数器都提供了直接结构依据。降速的是高位算术及部分采样后处理，并非必须丢弃原始周期的低位状态。[R01–R04]

整数与小数测量必须有显式的一致性机制。 双候选重定时、延迟匹配读出、冗余相位状态和整数周期修正均有公开依据。Havens 和 Sony 尤其说明，小数/多相状态不仅用于 fine phase，也可以反向校验 coarse epoch。[R01][R05][R07][R08][R10][R11]

物理选沿与短量程 TDC 可以用于 phase-domain ADPLL。 Kuo 2018、MediaTek 的选相专利，以及 Zong 2019 的 DTC/TDC 链分别提供不同实现。但“缩短 TDC 输入的真实时间间隔”与“数字上减去整周期”不是一回事。[R06][R09][R11]

#1.2 What the Existing Evidence Is Sufficient to Support

A wide counter can be split and rate-reduced. TI's /8 embodiment, Xu/Lindfors's /4 phase accumulator and ETRI's /4 counter all provide direct structural grounds. What is rate-reduced is the high-bit arithmetic and part of the post-sampling processing; the low-bit state of the raw cycles does not have to be discarded. [R01–R04]

Integer and fractional measurements require an explicit consistency mechanism. Dual-candidate retiming, delay-matched readout, redundant phase state and integer-cycle correction all have public grounds. Havens and Sony in particular show that fractional/multiphase state is used not only for the fine phase but can also be used, in the reverse direction, to check the coarse epoch. [R01][R05][R07][R08][R10][R11]

Physical edge selection and a short-range TDC can be used in a phase-domain ADPLL. Kuo 2018, MediaTek's phase-selection patent and Zong 2019's DTC/TDC chain each provide a different implementation. But "shortening the true time interval at the TDC input" and "digitally subtracting whole cycles" are not the same thing. [R06][R09][R11]

#1.3 本次必须纠正的三点

第一，不能通用地写成 8C+q+e/8+ϵ8C+q+e/8+\epsilon8C+q+e/8+ϵ。其中 qqq 可能已包含 eee 所表达的整周期位置；而 e/8e/8e/8 的单位也可能是分频后周期，不是原始 CKV 周期。必须先统一时钟节点、相位原点和量纲。

第二，不能把所有 epoch 错配都归结为 ±1 个原始周期。对于 N=MC+qN=MC+qN=MC+q，高、低位在组边界发生撕裂采样时，两个典型错误分别是相对相应合法状态的 −M-M−M 与 +M+M+M。/8 高位错一组与 raw-CKV 错一周期是不同故障。

第三，Sony 不是“此前没有共享状态方法”的证据起点。Havens 专利已同时包含整数计数、小数检测、sub-fractional TDC，以及利用小数状态消除 one-count uncertainty 的处理。Sony 的贡献应定位为另一条明确、紧凑的共享状态与修正实现，而不是本次搜索已经证明的最早先例。[R07][R08]

#1.3 Three Points That Must Be Corrected in This Round

First, one cannot generically write 8C+q+e/8+ϵ8C+q+e/8+\epsilon8C+q+e/8+ϵ. Here qqq may already contain the whole-cycle position expressed by eee; and the unit of e/8e/8e/8 may also be the divided-clock period rather than the raw CKV cycle. The clock node, the phase origin and the dimensions (units) must be unified first.

Second, not all epoch mismatches can be reduced to ±1 raw cycle. For N=MC+qN=MC+qN=MC+q, when torn sampling of the high and low bits occurs at a group boundary, the two typical errors are −M-M−M and +M+M+M, respectively, relative to the corresponding legal state. A /8 high-bit error of one group and a raw-CKV error of one cycle are different faults.

Third, Sony is not the starting point of the evidence for "no shared-state method existed before". The Havens patent already contains integer counting, fractional detection, a sub-fractional TDC, and processing that uses the fractional state to eliminate the one-count uncertainty. Sony's contribution should be positioned as another explicit, compact implementation of shared state and correction, not as the earliest precedent that this search has proven. [R07][R08]

#1.4 当前结论的边界

尚未核实到一篇与以下完整组合严格同构的公开实现：raw CKV 的 /8 高位计数 + 3-bit 原周期 residue + 该状态直接控制物理选沿 + short TDC + 完整 epoch/validity 接口。更强的工程扩展还包括 MASH future-edge planning、执行侧真实回执和 fine 饱和后的 coarse 接管。

“未核实到”只描述当前证据集，不能推导为“没有先前技术”。同样，能够把不同文献中的局部机制拼成合理架构，不等于组合后的时序、因果性和模拟误差已经通过验证。

#1.4 Boundaries of the Current Conclusions

No public implementation that is strictly isomorphic (structurally identical) to the following complete combination has been verified so far: /8 high-bit counting of raw CKV + a 3-bit raw-cycle residue + that state directly controlling physical edge selection + short TDC + a complete epoch/validity interface. Stronger engineering extensions further include MASH future-edge planning, a true execution-side receipt, and coarse takeover after fine saturation.

"Not verified" describes only the current evidence set and cannot be extrapolated to "there is no prior art". Likewise, being able to assemble local mechanisms from different publications into a plausible architecture does not mean that the timing, causality and analog errors of the combination have been verified.

#2 研究范围与需求冻结

#2 Research Scope and Requirements Freeze

#2.1 必须保持的目标

编号 需求 验收语义
G1 持续整数相位观测 CNT 记录实际 CKV 周期，不是只在目标命中时才记录命令状态
G2 高位降速 宽位高位允许在 /4 或 /8 域工作，少量低位状态可继续高速运行
G3 原周期编号不丢失 相位模型可追溯到所选原始 CKV 节点，而非只保留慢时钟边沿
G4 粗细观测一致 coarse 与 fine 对应同一物理锚点，或携带显式、可验证的坐标变换
G5 fine 真实量程受控 目标为约一个原始 CKV 周期或更小；必须按真实输入间隔检查
G6 边界与故障可辨识 wrap、采样错配、无效码、饱和、丢沿、重复沿不能静默变成有效相位
G7 P/S 不替代 CNT P/S 或 slot executor 负责物理边沿执行，不删除参考相关的 coarse 测量

上述需求继承前两份报告的目标；本次只澄清语义，没有把目标改为普通分频器研究。[H01][H02]

#2.1 Goals That Must Be Maintained

ID Requirement Acceptance semantics
G1 Continuous integer phase observation The CNT records the actual CKV cycles, rather than recording the command state only when a target is hit
G2 High-bit rate reduction The wide high bits are allowed to operate in the /4 or /8 domain; a small number of low-bit states may keep running at high speed
G3 Raw cycle index not lost The phase model is traceable to the selected raw CKV node, rather than retaining only slow-clock edges
G4 Coarse/fine observations consistent Coarse and fine correspond to the same physical anchor, or carry an explicit, verifiable coordinate transformation
G5 True fine range under control The target is about one raw CKV cycle or less; it must be checked against the true input interval
G6 Boundaries and faults identifiable Wrap, sampling mismatch, invalid codes, saturation, missing edges and duplicate edges must not silently become valid phase
G7 P/S does not replace the CNT P/S or the slot executor is responsible for physical edge execution and does not remove the reference-related coarse measurement

The above requirements inherit the goals of the two previous reports; this round only clarifies their semantics and does not change the goal into a study of ordinary dividers. [H01][H02]

#2.2 文献筛选的边界

优先纳入真正以 oscillator-cycle count / variable phase 参与主相位测量的 ADPLL/DPLL。高速计数器、retimer 和 selected-edge TDC 可以分别构成局部证据，但需要注明它们没有覆盖的接口。

通用 serializer、普通 fractional divider、phase-switching divider 可以作为门控、重定时或无毛刺选相的电路参考，不能仅因其有“/4”“多相”或“P/S”就认定与目标同构。[R18]

#2.2 Boundaries of the Literature Screening

Priority is given to ADPLLs/DPLLs in which the oscillator-cycle count / variable phase genuinely participates in the main phase measurement. High-speed counters, retimers and selected-edge TDCs can each constitute local evidence, but the interfaces they do not cover must be noted.

Generic serializers, ordinary fractional dividers and phase-switching dividers can serve as circuit references for gating, retiming or glitch-free phase selection, but they cannot be deemed isomorphic to the target merely because they involve "/4", "multiphase" or "P/S". [R18]

#2.3 证据等级与复核状态

标记 含义 本报告的使用规则
A-P 本次核对了专利原文及相关结构/说明 证明披露了某种方法；不等于硅片实测
A-J 本次核对了论文原文和关键图 论文内明确给出的结构可作为直接证据；不外推到本项目 PVT
B 官方元数据/摘要可核对，内部电路未充分核实 只保留为相关线索，不补写不可见连接
H 前轮报告保存了结论，本次未重新取得完整原始证据 保留历史贡献，明确不能与本次直接复核混称
D 本报告推导、示例或候选工程规范 不是原文公式、不是已完成的电路验证

证据等级评价的是支撑力度与读取范围，不是论文或专利本身的质量排序。H 也不表示内容必然错误，只表示本次的可复核链条尚不完整。

#2.3 Evidence Levels and Review Status

Mark Meaning Usage rule in this report
A-P The original patent text and the relevant structure/description were checked in this round Proves that a certain method was disclosed; is not the same as silicon measurement
A-J The original paper text and its key figures were checked in this round Structures explicitly given in the paper may serve as direct evidence; not extrapolated to this project's PVT
B Official metadata/abstract can be checked; the internal circuitry has not been sufficiently verified Kept only as a related lead; invisible connections are not filled in
H A previous-round report preserved the conclusion; the complete original evidence was not re-obtained in this round The historical contribution is retained, explicitly without being conflated with direct review in this round
D A derivation, example or candidate engineering specification of this report Not a formula from an original text, and not a completed circuit verification

The evidence level evaluates the strength of support and the scope of what was read, not a quality ranking of the papers or patents themselves. H also does not mean that the content is necessarily wrong; it only means that the reviewable chain in this round is incomplete.

#3 统一时钟节点与相位坐标

#3 Unified Clock Nodes and Phase Coordinates

#3.1 CKV、DCO、预分频输出不能跨文献直接同名代换

不同资料对 CKV 的命名不同。Bogdan 基线中的 CKV、Kuo 论文中的多相 CKV，以及 Zong 论文中经过前置分频的 CKV，不应被自动视为同一层级的振荡器节点。Zong 的系统图明确存在约 20 GHz 基波经过 /4 与 /2 后进入 phase detector 的 CKV；其 counter 内部的再分组是另一层问题。[R11]

本报告将希望完整保留周期编号的那个时钟节点统一称为 CK0CK_0CK0​，其周期为 T0T_0T0​、频率为 f0f_0f0​。它可能就是 LC DCO，也可能是已被工程明确选定的预分频节点。只要改变 CK0CK_0CK0​，所有 CNT 权重、FCW、fine 归一化和 edge ID 都必须一起换算。

CK0,T0,f0CK_0,T_0,f_0CK0​,T0​,f0​ 目标原始计数时钟及其周期、频率 s、Hz
MMM 高、低计数分组倍率 本报告主要取 4 或 8
CCC 高位组计数，经原点/延迟对齐后的值 一个计数代表 MMM 个 CK0CK_0CK0​ 周期
qqq 组内原周期 residue 0,…,M−10,\ldots,M-10,…,M−1；不是 TDC 小数码

μ\muμ 参考至被选边沿的有符号相位间隔 原周期
TdT_dTd​ 分组慢时钟的周期 Td=MT0T_d=MT_0Td​=MT0​，理想固定倍率

#3.1 CKV, DCO and Prescaler Outputs Cannot Be Substituted for One Another Across Publications by Name Alone

Different sources name CKV differently. The CKV in the Bogdan baseline, the multiphase CKV in the Kuo paper and the pre-divided CKV in the Zong paper should not automatically be regarded as oscillator nodes at the same level. Zong's system diagram explicitly contains a CKV obtained by passing the roughly 20 GHz fundamental through /4 and /2 before it enters the phase detector; the regrouping inside its counter is a separate issue. [R11]

This report uniformly calls the clock node whose cycle index is to be fully preserved CK0CK_0CK0​, with period T0T_0T0​ and frequency f0f_0f0​. It may be the LC DCO itself, or a prescaled node that has been explicitly chosen by the engineering design. Whenever CK0CK_0CK0​ is changed, all CNT weights, the FCW, the fine normalization and the edge IDs must be converted together.

Symbol Definition Unit/range
CK0,T0,f0CK_0,T_0,f_0CK0​,T0​,f0​ The target raw counting clock and its period and frequency s, Hz
MMM Grouping ratio between the high and low counts This report mainly uses 4 or 8
CCC High-bit group count, value after origin/delay alignment One count represents MMM cycles of CK0CK_0CK0​
qqq In-group raw-cycle residue 0,…,M−10,\ldots,M-10,…,M−1; not a TDC fractional code
NNN Integer raw-cycle index N=MC+qN=MC+qN=MC+q
JJJ Absolute index of a specific actual raw rising edge Raw cycles
α\alphaα Intra-cycle offset of the selected edge relative to that rising edge Raw cycles; added only when this degree of freedom exists independently
μ\muμ Signed phase interval from the reference to the selected edge Raw cycles
TdT_dTd​ Period of the grouped slow clock Td=MT0T_d=MT_0Td​=MT0​, ideal fixed ratio

#3.2 整数分解是定义，不是 CDC 正确性的证明

对已对齐的、逻辑一致的状态，定义：

N=MC+q,C=floor⁡(N/M),q=N mod M.(1)N=MC+q,\qquad C=\operatorname{floor}(N/M),\quad q=N\bmod M. \tag{1}N=MC+q,C=floor(N/M),q=NmodM.(1)

合法连续计数必须满足：

(C,M−1)⟶(C+1,0).(2)(C,M-1)\longrightarrow(C+1,0). \tag{2}(C,M−1)⟶(C+1,0).(2)

式 (1) 对正确状态当然成立，但不能由此证明“任意时刻独立采样 C 和 q 后拼接都正确”。后者是电路的同步、延迟匹配、编码和边界校正问题。

此外，普通二进制 q[2]q[2]q[2] 的上升沿对应低三位 3→4，下降沿对应 7→0。因此，“把 q 的最高位当 /8 时钟”之后，还必须核对高位触发极性、复位原点及流水延迟。不能只看信号名 CKVD8 就默认它的某个有效沿等于式 (2) 的 carry。

#3.2 The Integer Decomposition Is a Definition, Not a Proof of CDC Correctness

For aligned, logically consistent states, define:

N=MC+q,C=floor⁡(N/M),q=N mod M.(1)N=MC+q,\qquad C=\operatorname{floor}(N/M),\quad q=N\bmod M. \tag{1}N=MC+q,C=floor(N/M),q=NmodM.(1)

A legal continuous count must satisfy:

(C,M−1)⟶(C+1,0).(2)(C,M-1)\longrightarrow(C+1,0). \tag{2}(C,M−1)⟶(C+1,0).(2)

Eq. (1) of course holds for correct states, but it cannot be used to prove that "independently sampling C and q at an arbitrary moment and concatenating them is always correct". The latter is a question of the circuit's synchronization, delay matching, encoding and boundary correction.

In addition, for ordinary binary, the rising edge of q[2]q[2]q[2] corresponds to the low three bits going 3→4, while its falling edge corresponds to 7→0. Therefore, after "using the MSB of q as the /8 clock", one must still check the trigger polarity of the high bits, the reset origin and the pipeline delay. One cannot assume, merely from the signal name CKVD8, that one of its active edges is equal to the carry of Eq. (2).

#3.3 完整相位的通用表达

以连续展开的原时钟相位 Φ0(t)\Phi_0(t)Φ0​(t) 为定义，实际被选物理边沿的坐标记为：

Ak=Jk+αk.(3)A_k=J_k+\alpha_k. \tag{3}Ak​=Jk​+αk​.(3)

从参考事件 tR,kt_{R,k}tR,k​ 到该边沿 tE,kt_{E,k}tE,k​ 的精确相位间隔为：

μk=∫tR,ktE,kf0(t) dt.(4)\mu_k=\int_{t_{R,k}}^{t_{E,k}} f_0(t)\,dt. \tag{4}μk​=∫tR,k​tE,k​​f0​(t)dt.(4)

于是：

Φ0(tR,k)=Ak−μk.(5)\Phi_0(t_{R,k})=A_k-\mu_k. \tag{5}Φ0​(tR,k​)=Ak​−μk​.(5)

这里 μ\muμ 的符号由积分上下限决定；选择 preceding edge 或 following edge 都可用同一公式，不再用一个未定义的“±TDC”掩盖约定。

在一个局部间隔内近似频率恒定，才有：

μ^k≈Δt^kT^0[k].(6)\widehat{\mu}_k\approx\frac{\widehat{\Delta t}_k}{\widehat T_0[k]}. \tag{6}μ​k​≈T0​[k]Δtk​​.(6)

快速调频、强瞬态或跨多个周期时，应评估式 (6) 相对式 (4) 的误差。若间隔内频率估计误差有界为 δfmax\delta f_{max}δfmax​，则有简单上界 ∣δμ∣≤δfmax∣Δt∣|\delta\mu|\leq\delta f_{max}|\Delta t|∣δμ∣≤δfmax​∣Δt∣。这也是为什么过长的 selected-edge 间隔不宜仅靠固定周期归一化。

#3.3 General Expression of the Complete Phase

Taking the continuously unwrapped raw-clock phase Φ0(t)\Phi_0(t)Φ0​(t) as the definition, the coordinate of the physical edge actually selected is written as:

Ak=Jk+αk.(3)A_k=J_k+\alpha_k. \tag{3}Ak​=Jk​+αk​.(3)

The exact phase interval from the reference event tR,kt_{R,k}tR,k​ to that edge tE,kt_{E,k}tE,k​ is:

μk=∫tR,ktE,kf0(t) dt.(4)\mu_k=\int_{t_{R,k}}^{t_{E,k}} f_0(t)\,dt. \tag{4}μk​=∫tR,k​tE,k​​f0​(t)dt.(4)

Hence:

Φ0(tR,k)=Ak−μk.(5)\Phi_0(t_{R,k})=A_k-\mu_k. \tag{5}Φ0​(tR,k​)=Ak​−μk​.(5)

Here the sign of μ\muμ is determined by the limits of integration; the same formula applies whether the preceding edge or the following edge is selected, and an undefined "±TDC" is no longer used to mask the convention.

Only if the frequency is approximately constant within a local interval do we have:

μ^k≈Δt^kT^0[k].(6)\widehat{\mu}_k\approx\frac{\widehat{\Delta t}_k}{\widehat T_0[k]}. \tag{6}μ​k​≈T0​[k]Δtk​​.(6)

Under fast frequency modulation, strong transients, or intervals spanning multiple cycles, the error of Eq. (6) relative to Eq. (4) should be evaluated. If the frequency-estimate error within the interval is bounded by δfmax\delta f_{max}δfmax​, there is a simple upper bound ∣δμ∣≤δfmax∣Δt∣|\delta\mu|\leq\delta f_{max}|\Delta t|∣δμ∣≤δfmax​∣Δt∣. This is also why an overly long selected-edge interval should not rely solely on fixed-period normalization.

#3.4 为什么不能直接叠加 q 和 Octal

以一个理想 /4、八相均匀分布且相位原点对齐的示例说明。若 a=0…7a=0\ldots7a=0…7 是分频后周期内的八相区域，则：

Φd=Cd+a8+ϵd.\Phi_d=C_d+\frac{a}{8}+\epsilon_d.Φd​=Cd​+8a​+ϵd​.

换算为原周期：

Φ0=4Φd=4Cd+a2+4ϵd.(7)\Phi_0=4\Phi_d=4C_d+\frac{a}{2}+4\epsilon_d. \tag{7}Φ0​=4Φd​=4Cd​+2a​+4ϵd​.(7)

再令 q=floor⁡(a/2)q=\operatorname{floor}(a/2)q=floor(a/2)、p=a mod 2p=a\bmod2p=amod2，得到：

Φ0=4Cd+q+p2+ϵ0,ϵ0=4ϵd.(8)\Phi_0=4C_d+q+\frac{p}{2}+\epsilon_0,\qquad\epsilon_0=4\epsilon_d. \tag{8}Φ0​=4Cd​+q+2p​+ϵ0​,ϵ0​=4ϵd​.(8)

此时 a 已经含有 q 的信息；再把 q+a/8q+a/8q+a/8 相加就是混合单位并可能重复计数。式 (7)–(8) 是量纲推导，不是对某篇原文 decoder truth table 的逐码复刻。真实电路还需要处理相位排列、边沿极性、DCC 和原点偏置。

#3.4 Why q and Octal Cannot Simply Be Added Together

Consider an example with an ideal /4, eight phases uniformly distributed, and phase origins aligned. If a=0…7a=0\ldots7a=0…7 is the eight-phase region within one divided-clock period, then:

Φd=Cd+a8+ϵd.\Phi_d=C_d+\frac{a}{8}+\epsilon_d.Φd​=Cd​+8a​+ϵd​.

Converted to raw cycles:

Φ0=4Φd=4Cd+a2+4ϵd.(7)\Phi_0=4\Phi_d=4C_d+\frac{a}{2}+4\epsilon_d. \tag{7}Φ0​=4Φd​=4Cd​+2a​+4ϵd​.(7)

Further letting q=floor⁡(a/2)q=\operatorname{floor}(a/2)q=floor(a/2) and p=a mod 2p=a\bmod2p=amod2, we obtain:

Φ0=4Cd+q+p2+ϵ0,ϵ0=4ϵd.(8)\Phi_0=4C_d+q+\frac{p}{2}+\epsilon_0,\qquad\epsilon_0=4\epsilon_d. \tag{8}Φ0​=4Cd​+q+2p​+ϵ0​,ϵ0​=4ϵd​.(8)

At this point a already contains the information of q; adding q+a/8q+a/8q+a/8 on top of it mixes units and may count the same information twice. Eqs. (7)–(8) are a dimensional derivation, not a code-by-code replica of the decoder truth table of any original paper. A real circuit must also handle phase ordering, edge polarity, DCC and origin offsets.

#4 文献证据：逐项解释其价值和边界

#4 Literature Evidence: Explaining the Value and Boundaries of Each Item

#4.1 TI：/8 高低位分解与 SEL_EDGE 候选选择

来源： US20050195917A1，Method and apparatus for crystal drift compensation，Staszewski / Leipold；同族 WO2005086759A2。核心在 Fig.4，而非仅看标题。[R01]

原文给出 CKV 驱动的 mod-8 低位 RV<2:0>、CKVD8 驱动的高位 RV<8:3>，以及分别在 CKV 上升沿、下降沿采样 FREF 得到的两套重定时/低位采样候选；SEL_EDGE 参与候选选择。CKVD8 还承担部分延迟处理。

证据价值： 直接证明少量高速低位状态与降频高位可以组成 VPA，且 fine-side 边沿判定可参与 coarse 路径选择。

边界： 它不能被解释为“先把 fine TDC 输入统一变为 8T0，再由 snapshot 自动压缩成 T0”，也不直接披露本项目的 P/S 绝对边沿执行器。高位极性与流水原点应以 Fig.4 逐路径核对，不能机械拼接。

#4.1 TI: /8 High/Low Decomposition and SEL_EDGE Candidate Selection

Source: US20050195917A1, Method and apparatus for crystal drift compensation, Staszewski / Leipold; same family as WO2005086759A2. The core lies in Fig.4; the title alone is not enough. [R01]

The original text gives the CKV-driven mod-8 low bits RV<2:0>, the CKVD8-driven high bits RV<8:3>, and two sets of retiming / low-bit sampling candidates obtained by sampling FREF on the CKV rising edge and on the CKV falling edge, respectively; SEL_EDGE participates in the candidate selection. CKVD8 also takes on part of the delay processing.

Evidence value: It directly proves that a small amount of high-speed low-bit state and rate-reduced high bits can together form a VPA, and that the fine-side edge decision can participate in selecting the coarse path.

Boundary: It cannot be interpreted as "first making the fine TDC input uniformly 8T0, and then letting the snapshot automatically compress it into T0", nor does it directly disclose this project's P/S absolute-edge executor. The high-bit polarity and the pipeline origin should be checked path by path against Fig.4, and must not be mechanically concatenated.

#4.2 Xu / Lindfors：/4 快速状态，先采样再编码

来源： ISCAS 2008 论文与 WO2009053531A1，Phase accumulator for digital phase locked loop。[R02][R03]

专利的示例使用低速高六位 modulo incrementer 和高速移位状态。低位信息在 CKR 采样后由 4-to-2 encoder 恢复；某些实施方式还使用高计数器最低位参与解码。相关结构/真值表见 Fig.6–7。

证据价值： “原周期 residue 必须保留”不等于“一定用高速二进制低位加法器”。高速侧可以保存易于实现的状态，慢速侧再解码。

边界： 状态编码并不免除 epoch 一致性。该资料不能单独证明同一低位状态已经控制 short-TDC 的物理选沿，也不能把所有 encoder 输入假定为独立同步的普通总线。

#4.2 Xu / Lindfors: /4 Fast State, Sampled First and Then Encoded

Source: the ISCAS 2008 paper and WO2009053531A1, Phase accumulator for digital phase locked loop. [R02][R03]

The patent's example uses a low-speed modulo incrementer for the upper six bits and a high-speed shift state. The low-bit information is recovered by a 4-to-2 encoder after sampling by CKR; some embodiments also use the least significant bit of the high counter in the decoding. The related structures/truth tables are in Fig.6–7.

Evidence value: "The raw-cycle residue must be preserved" is not the same as "a high-speed binary low-bit adder must be used". The high-speed side can hold a state that is easy to implement, and the low-speed side can decode it afterwards.

Boundary: State encoding does not exempt the design from epoch consistency. This source alone cannot prove that the same low-bit state already controls the physical edge selection of a short TDC, nor can all encoder inputs be assumed to form an ordinary, independently synchronized bus.

#4.3 ETRI：/4 carry 与连续计数的直接实例

来源： US20130156147A1，High speed counter apparatus。[R04]

该实施例使用低两位状态形成与 carry 相关的 CKVD4，并由其驱动高位；描述了低位 11→00 与高位进位的关系，组合得到连续的 8-bit 计数。

证据价值： 可用于核对式 (1)–(2) 所要求的 count lineage：慢计数不能只是任意同频 /4 时钟驱动，必须与低位 wrap 在逻辑上关联。

边界： 连续计数成立，不等于参考相关 snapshot 已经安全；此来源也不是共享 short-TDC、selected-edge 和完整相位重建的证明。

#4.3 ETRI: A Direct Example of a /4 Carry and Continuous Counting

Source: US20130156147A1, High speed counter apparatus. [R04]

This embodiment uses the low two-bit state to form a carry-related CKVD4, which drives the high bits; it describes the relationship between the low bits' 11→00 transition and the high-bit carry, and the combination yields a continuous 8-bit count.

Evidence value: It can be used to check the count lineage required by Eqs. (1)–(2): the slow count must not be driven by just any /4 clock of the same frequency; it must be logically tied to the low-bit wrap.

Boundary: That continuous counting holds does not mean that the reference-related snapshot is already safe; this source is also not a proof of a shared short TDC, a selected edge, or complete phase reconstruction.

#4.4 CN105071798：把采样延迟匹配到计数传播

来源： CN105071798A，应用于全数字PLL的低功耗相位累加器，重点 Fig.4–6。[R05]

该方案以异步低位和同步高位降低计数功耗，将 CKR 的采样时刻按各级传播延迟展开，再统一重采样输出。其方法针对的是“各位并非同时稳定”，不是要求所有位物理上同一时刻锁存。

证据价值： 相干快照的本质是同一逻辑 epoch，而不是所有寄存器使用零偏差时钟。

边界： 最终统一输出并不自动证明中间每一级的 setup/hold 满足。必须同时校验数据和采样路径的 min/max 延迟、同源误差与 PVT 差异；延迟链不能被当作理想常数。

#4.4 CN105071798: Matching the Sampling Delay to the Count Propagation

Source: CN105071798A, Low-power phase accumulator applied to an all-digital PLL (original title: 应用于全数字PLL的低功耗相位累加器), focusing on Fig.4–6. [R05]

This scheme reduces counting power by using asynchronous low bits and synchronous high bits, spreads out the CKR sampling instants according to the propagation delay of each stage, and then resamples everything into a unified output. Its method addresses the fact that "the bits do not settle simultaneously"; it does not require all bits to be physically latched at the same instant.

Evidence value: The essence of a coherent snapshot is the same logical epoch, not that all registers use a zero-skew clock.

Boundary: The final unified output does not automatically prove that setup/hold is met at every intermediate stage. The min/max delays of both the data paths and the sampling paths, the same-source errors and the PVT differences must all be verified together; the delay chain cannot be treated as an ideal constant.

#4.5 Kuo 2018：八相选相与 short TDC，但必须换对单位

来源： F.-W. Kuo et al., TCAS-I 2018；Fig.2、Fig.5–6 为重点。[R06]

该 ADPLL 将 DCO 的 /4 输出构成八相 CKV，配合预测选相、短 TDC 和多候选参考重定时。Octal 信息与 fine TDC 配合，而 variable phase 另有整数采样路径。论文实验部分给出的 DCO 调谐范围为 5.7–8.4 GHz；/4 后相应为 1.425–2.1 GHz。

必须修正： 论文中“约 2 GHz”的节点不能误写成“原始 DCO 约 2 GHz 再 /4”。八相区域的 TV/8T_V/8TV​/8 以论文 CKV 周期为基准；若换算到前置 /4 之前的周期 T0T_0T0​，其理想间隔是 T0/2T_0/2T0​/2，不是 T0/8T_0/8T0​/8。

边界： 该实现是周期内多相选择，不能未经映射就等同于 raw-CKV 的 3-bit /8 integer residue 或 whole-cycle slot executor。

#4.5 Kuo 2018: Eight-Phase Selection and a Short TDC, but the Units Must Be Converted Correctly

Source: F.-W. Kuo et al., TCAS-I 2018; Fig.2 and Fig.5–6 are the key figures. [R06]

This ADPLL forms an eight-phase CKV from the /4 output of the DCO, combined with predictive phase selection, a short TDC and multi-candidate reference retiming. The Octal information works together with the fine TDC, while the variable phase has a separate integer sampling path. The experimental section of the paper gives a DCO tuning range of 5.7–8.4 GHz; after /4 this corresponds to 1.425–2.1 GHz.

Must be corrected: The "about 2 GHz" node in the paper must not be miswritten as "the raw DCO is about 2 GHz and is then divided by 4". The TV/8T_V/8TV​/8 of the eight-phase regions is referenced to the paper's CKV period; if converted to the period T0T_0T0​ before the preceding /4, the ideal spacing is T0/2T_0/2T0​/2, not T0/8T_0/8T0​/8.

Boundary: This implementation is an intra-cycle multiphase selection and cannot, without a mapping, be equated with a raw-CKV 3-bit /8 integer residue or with a whole-cycle slot executor.

#4.6 Havens：比 Sony 更早的共享状态与 sub-fractional 检测

来源： US8692598B2，Digital phase locked loop，J. H. Havens；重点 Fig.2–4。[R08]

其反馈计数器同时包含 integer、fractional 和 sub-fractional TDC。整数值由高位 cnt[7:1] 与分频状态 ckh[0] 组成；多相半速状态被采样用于 fractional detector，并保留 even/odd 信息，以处理同步器引入的 one-count uncertainty。

证据价值： 共享状态、整数边界校验和更细的 TDC 测量并非直到 Sony 才出现。它同时说明，冗余状态的覆盖范围必须与可能的 epoch 错误匹配。

边界： 这里的 half-rate / parity 结构不能直接替代 /8 block-epoch 检查。其 sub-fractional 实现也不是未经修改就等同 Kuo 的预测选相后单个 short TDC。

#4.6 Havens: Shared State and Sub-fractional Detection Earlier Than Sony

Source: US8692598B2, Digital phase locked loop, J. H. Havens; focusing on Fig.2–4. [R08]

Its feedback counter contains integer, fractional and sub-fractional TDC parts at the same time. The integer value is composed of the high bits cnt[7:1] and the divider state ckh[0]; the multiphase half-rate state is sampled for the fractional detector, and the even/odd information is retained in order to handle the one-count uncertainty introduced by the synchronizer.

Evidence value: Shared state, integer-boundary checking and finer TDC measurement did not first appear with Sony. It also shows that the coverage of the redundant state must match the possible epoch errors.

Boundary: The half-rate / parity structure here cannot directly replace a /8 block-epoch check. Its sub-fractional implementation is also not, without modification, equivalent to Kuo's single short TDC after predictive phase selection.

#4.7 Sony：明确的整数/分频状态复用与两个 XOR 修正

来源： US11936392B2，Phase locked loop, electronic device, and method for controlling phase locked loop，Kurihara / Fujiwara；Fig.6、Fig.11–12。[R07]

CNTO[0] 与慢 accumulator 高位共同形成整数码；CNTO[3:0] 又由 REFCLK 直接采为 VFRAC。VINT 则经过参考重定时后采样。原文据两条路径的状态差异，生成：

CRRCT=VINT[0]⊕VFRAC[0],SIGN=VFRAC[0]⊕VFRAC[3].(9)CRRCT=VINT[0]\oplus VFRAC[0],\qquad SIGN=VFRAC[0]\oplus VFRAC[3]. \tag{9}CRRCT=VINT[0]⊕VFRAC[0],SIGN=VFRAC[0]⊕VFRAC[3].(9)
CRRCT SIGN 原实施例送往 phase comparator 的修正
0 任意 0
1 0 −1
1 1 +1

边界： 该实施例用多相 latch/correction 替代比较例中的传统 TDC；不能说它已接上本项目 short TDC。VFRAC 是带周期冗余的状态码，Fig.12 的值跨至 1.75，并非普通纯小数二进制。修正量的“1”必须按其原相位单位解释。[R07]

不能从式 (9) 推出对任意异步错误都保证唯一复原。该专利原文个别 retiming 节点/位序表述也需结合 Fig.6、8、11、12 交叉确认，本文不把网页中的全局相位公式直接转写为 RTL。

#4.7 Sony: Explicit Reuse of Integer/Divider State and Two XOR Corrections

Source: US11936392B2, Phase locked loop, electronic device, and method for controlling phase locked loop, Kurihara / Fujiwara; Fig.6, Fig.11–12. [R07]

CNTO[0] together with the high bits of the slow accumulator forms the integer code; CNTO[3:0] is in addition sampled directly by REFCLK as VFRAC. VINT, by contrast, is sampled after reference retiming. Based on the state difference between the two paths, the original text generates:

CRRCT=VINT[0]⊕VFRAC[0],SIGN=VFRAC[0]⊕VFRAC[3].(9)CRRCT=VINT[0]\oplus VFRAC[0],\qquad SIGN=VFRAC[0]\oplus VFRAC[3]. \tag{9}CRRCT=VINT[0]⊕VFRAC[0],SIGN=VFRAC[0]⊕VFRAC[3].(9)
CRRCT SIGN Correction sent to the phase comparator in the original embodiment
0 Any 0
1 0 −1
1 1 +1

Boundary: This embodiment uses multiphase latch/correction in place of the conventional TDC of the comparative example; one cannot say it has already been connected to this project's short TDC. VFRAC is a state code carrying cycle-level redundancy; the values in Fig.12 extend up to 1.75, so it is not an ordinary pure-fraction binary code. The "1" of the correction amount must be interpreted in its original phase unit. [R07]

One cannot infer from Eq. (9) that unique recovery is guaranteed for arbitrary asynchronous errors. Some individual statements about retiming nodes/bit order in the original patent text also need to be cross-checked against Fig.6, 8, 11 and 12; this document does not directly transcribe the global phase formula found on the web page into RTL.

#4.8 MediaTek 与 Marvell：坐标偏移与独立边界校验

US8593182B2： raw-CKV VPA 与 shifted CKV′ 的 TDC 路径共存，使用附加的 PHF2 补偿选相坐标；原文给出 PHE=PHR+PHF1+PHF2−PHVPHE=PHR+PHF1+PHF2-PHVPHE=PHR+PHF1+PHF2−PHV，并有单脉冲相关实施例。它支持“保留原 CNT，同时显式补偿 selected edge offset”。但 whole-cycle absolute-edge executor 是本项目的进一步综合，不是该公式自动完成的功能。[R09]

US9306586B2： 使用 RF counter/TDC skew correction 及独立的边界估计信息，判断 fractional code 应接近 0 还是 1，从而修正整周期错配。它提示不能让 fine code 同时承担全部的范围、边界和自我可信性判断；估计器自身的模糊区域同样要约束。[R10]

#4.8 MediaTek and Marvell: Coordinate Offset and Independent Boundary Checking

US8593182B2: a raw-CKV VPA coexists with a TDC path on the shifted CKV′, and an additional PHF2 is used to compensate the phase-selection coordinate; the original text gives PHE=PHR+PHF1+PHF2−PHVPHE=PHR+PHF1+PHF2-PHVPHE=PHR+PHF1+PHF2−PHV, and there is a related single-pulse embodiment. It supports "preserving the original CNT while explicitly compensating the selected edge offset". However, the whole-cycle absolute-edge executor is a further synthesis made by this project, not a function that this formula accomplishes automatically. [R09]

US9306586B2: uses RF counter/TDC skew correction together with independent boundary-estimation information to judge whether the fractional code should be close to 0 or close to 1, thereby correcting whole-cycle mismatch. It suggests that the fine code should not be made to bear all of the range, boundary and self-trustworthiness judgments at once; the ambiguous region of the estimator itself must also be constrained. [R10]

#4.9 Zong 2019：同一实芯片中的 split counter、匹配读出和 DTC/TDC

来源： Z. Zong, P. Chen, R. B. Staszewski, JSSC 2019；Fig.1、Fig.9–10。[R11]

8-bit PHV_I 使用两位异步低位和六位同步高位。Fig.9 的 CKS_0/1/2 沿采样链匹配计数传播；正文说明，在匹配条件下采样位于计数位稳定后的约半个 CKV 周期。系统还采用 DTC-assisted TDC，检测溢出/下溢并在瞬态采用限幅输出。

证据价值： 这是 split counter、明确采样时序和有限 TDC 在同一 ADPLL 内共存的直接论文证据。

边界： Fig.1 的 CKV 已是约 20 GHz 基波经 /8 后的节点，不能把 Fig.9 的低两位等同于“20 GHz 基波全部周期的低两位”。其饱和限幅策略也不能等同于“饱和仍是精确 fine”或本项目已经验证的 coarse-only fallback。

#4.9 Zong 2019: Split Counter, Matched Readout and DTC/TDC in the Same Real Chip

Source: Z. Zong, P. Chen, R. B. Staszewski, JSSC 2019; Fig.1, Fig.9–10. [R11]

The 8-bit PHV_I uses two asynchronous low bits and six synchronous high bits. In Fig.9, CKS_0/1/2 match the count propagation along the sampling chain; the text states that, under the matching condition, sampling takes place about half a CKV cycle after the count bits have settled. The system also adopts a DTC-assisted TDC, which detects overflow/underflow and uses a clamped output during transients.

Evidence value: This is direct paper evidence that a split counter, explicit sampling timing and a finite-range TDC coexist within the same ADPLL.

Boundary: The CKV in Fig.1 is already a node obtained by passing the roughly 20 GHz fundamental through /8, so the low two bits in Fig.9 cannot be equated with "the low two bits of every cycle of the 20 GHz fundamental". Its saturation-clamping strategy also cannot be equated with "the fine value remains exact under saturation", nor with a coarse-only fallback already verified for this project.

这些来源支持三类相互补充的方法：TI/Xu/ETRI 解释如何保存周期状态；CN/Zong/Havens/Sony/Marvell 解释如何保持或恢复一致性；Kuo/MediaTek 解释物理选相和局部 fine 测量。表中的空白不是格式遗漏，而是仍需完成的接口论证。

本报告不按“哪篇最像”给出单一无条件结论。若关注 /8 split，TI 最直接；若关注共享状态与修正，Havens/Sony 更直接；若关注 short TDC 物理选相，Kuo/MediaTek 更直接；若关注 split counter 的采样波形，Zong Fig.9 最适合作为当前核对入口。这是按问题分工，不是把某篇说成完整目标的替代品。
