These sources support three classes of mutually complementary methods: TI/Xu/ETRI explain how to preserve the cycle state; CN/Zong/Havens/Sony/Marvell explain how to maintain or recover consistency; Kuo/MediaTek explain physical phase selection and local fine measurement. The gaps in the table are not formatting omissions; they are interface arguments that still have to be completed.

This report does not give a single, unconditional conclusion based on “which publication is the closest match”. If the concern is the /8 split, TI is the most direct; if the concern is shared state and correction, Havens/Sony are more direct; if the concern is physical phase selection for a short TDC, Kuo/MediaTek are more direct; if the concern is the sampling waveforms of a split counter, Zong Fig.9 is the most suitable current entry point for checking. This is a division of labour by question, not a claim that any one publication is a substitute for the complete target.

#6 核心难点一：epoch 错误必须按层级分类

#6 Core Difficulty 1: Epoch Errors Must Be Classified by Level

#6.1 /8 跨组例子：两个合法数与两个撕裂数

设旧状态为 C=10,q=7C=10,q=7C=10,q=7，下一原始边沿触发低位回零、高位进位。对应：

状态 高位 C 低位 q 8C+q 含义
跨组前 10 7 87 合法旧状态
跨组后 11 0 88 合法新状态
旧高位 + 新低位 10 0 80 相对新状态 88 错 −8
新高位 + 旧低位 11 7 95 相对旧状态 87 错 +8

这个例子不是模拟某篇专利，而是式 (1) 下的故障注入推导。它证明：当故障属于高低字撕裂，仅允许 ±1 raw cycle 的修正器覆盖不了上述两种错误。

相对另一侧合法锚点比较时，差值也可能表现为 ±7。因此必须先指定应该关联的旧/新 epoch，不能只凭错误绝对值反推修正类别。

#6.1 A /8 Group-Boundary Example: Two Legal Values and Two Torn Values

Let the old state be C=10,q=7C=10,q=7C=10,q=7, and let the next raw edge cause the low bits to wrap to zero and the high bits to carry. The corresponding states are:

State High bits C Low bits q 8C+q Meaning
Before the group-boundary crossing 10 7 87 Legal old state
After the group-boundary crossing 11 0 88 Legal new state
Old high bits + new low bits 10 0 80 Off by −8 relative to the new state 88
New high bits + old low bits 11 7 95 Off by +8 relative to the old state 87

This example does not simulate any particular patent; it is a fault-injection derivation under Eq. (1). It proves that when the fault is high-low word tearing, a corrector that allows only ±1 raw cycle cannot cover the two errors above.

When compared against the legal anchor on the other side, the difference may also appear as ±7. Therefore it must first be specified which old/new epoch should be associated; the correction class cannot be inferred backwards from the absolute value of the error alone.

#6.2 raw-cycle correction 与 block correction 分开定义

建议相位整合接口写为：

Ncorr=M(Ccap+κC)+qcorr+κN.(10)N_{\mathrm{corr}}=M(C_{\mathrm{cap}}+\kappa_C)+q_{\mathrm{corr}}+\kappa_N. \tag{10}Ncorr​=M(Ccap​+κC​)+qcorr​+κN​.(10)

其中 κC\kappa_CκC​ 单位为一个慢计数组，κN\kappa_NκN​ 单位为一个原始 CKV 周期；qcorrq_{\mathrm{corr}}qcorr​ 还可能是经合法码/状态重构后的 residue。不要用同一个无单位 kappa 混合三种职责。

κC∈{−1,0,+1}\kappa_C\in\{-1,0,+1\}κC​∈{−1,0,+1} 只有在采样延迟及同步延迟已证明最多跨一组时才合理。如果捕获可延迟多组，修正集合必须扩展，或直接将该观测判为无效。校正范围是一项由时序上界导出的规范，不是预先任意选的编码宽度。

#6.2 Defining Raw-Cycle Correction and Block Correction Separately

It is recommended that the phase-integration interface be written as:

Ncorr=M(Ccap+κC)+qcorr+κN.(10)N_{\mathrm{corr}}=M(C_{\mathrm{cap}}+\kappa_C)+q_{\mathrm{corr}}+\kappa_N. \tag{10}Ncorr​=M(Ccap​+κC​)+qcorr​+κN​.(10)

Here the unit of κC\kappa_CκC​ is one slow count group, and the unit of κN\kappa_NκN​ is one raw CKV cycle; qcorrq_{\mathrm{corr}}qcorr​ may further be a residue reconstructed from legal codes/states. Do not use a single unitless kappa to mix three responsibilities.

κC∈{−1,0,+1}\kappa_C\in\{-1,0,+1\}κC​∈{−1,0,+1} is reasonable only when the sampling delay and the synchronization delay have been proven to span at most one group. If the capture can be delayed by multiple groups, the correction set must be extended, or the observation must be declared invalid outright. The correction range is a specification derived from timing upper bounds, not an encoding width chosen arbitrarily in advance.

#6.3 为什么“看 q 或 raw parity”可能完全看不出高位错组

对 M=4M=4M=4 或 8：

(N+M) mod M=N mod M,(N+M)\bmod M=N\bmod M,(N+M)modM=NmodM,

而且：

(N+M) mod 2=N mod 2.(11)(N+M)\bmod2=N\bmod2. \tag{11}(N+M)mod2=Nmod2.(11)

因此，一个完整组的误差不改变 q，也不改变原周期的奇偶性。直接把 Havens/Sony 的某个 low-bit XOR 搬到 /8 模型，未必能检测高位错组。

要检测 block mismatch，需要额外保留能跨组翻转的状态，例如高位最低位的独立观测、wrap toggle/sequence，或者保证高位取自确定候选 epoch 的捕获协议。即便使用高位 parity，也只能在错误已被限定到相邻组时区分；相差两个组会再次出现别名。这是冗余码覆盖范围问题。

#6.3 Why “Looking at q or the Raw Parity” May Completely Miss a High-Bit Group Error

For M=4M=4M=4 or 8:

(N+M) mod M=N mod M,(N+M)\bmod M=N\bmod M,(N+M)modM=NmodM,

and moreover:

(N+M) mod 2=N mod 2.(11)(N+M)\bmod2=N\bmod2. \tag{11}(N+M)mod2=Nmod2.(11)

Therefore an error of one whole group changes neither q nor the parity of the raw cycle. Transplanting one of Havens/Sony's low-bit XORs directly into the /8 model will not necessarily detect a high-bit group error.

To detect a block mismatch, additional state that toggles across groups must be retained, for example an independent observation of the least significant bit of the high bits, a wrap toggle/sequence, or a capture protocol that guarantees the high bits are taken from a determined candidate epoch. Even if high-bit parity is used, it can discriminate only when the error has already been confined to an adjacent group; a difference of two groups aliases again. This is a question of the coverage of the redundant code.

#6.4 边界允许两种坐标，但不能允许两条链各选一种

设参考正好靠近相邻边沿 J 与 J+1。下面两个相位表示相同：

J−μ=(J+1)−(μ+1).(12)J-\mu=(J+1)-(\mu+1). \tag{12}J−μ=(J+1)−(μ+1).(12)

因此，合格的 coarse/fine 交接不一定需要每次都选择预先认定的唯一边沿。它需要所选整数锚点与 fine interval 共同变换。整数取 J+1、fine 却仍相对 J，才会生成一个周期的错误。

式 (12) 是精确相位域等式。用单个平均周期把长时间间隔归一化时，还要满足第 3.3 节的近似条件。不能把代数一致性误当作任意时域模型都精确。

#6.4 The Boundary Admits Two Coordinates, but the Two Chains Must Not Each Choose a Different One

Suppose the reference lies right near the adjacent edges J and J+1. The following two phase representations are identical:

J−μ=(J+1)−(μ+1).(12)J-\mu=(J+1)-(\mu+1). \tag{12}J−μ=(J+1)−(μ+1).(12)

Therefore a valid coarse/fine handover does not necessarily need to select a unique, pre-designated edge every time. What it needs is that the selected integer anchor and the fine interval transform together. Only when the integer takes J+1 while the fine value is still relative to J is a one-cycle error produced.

Eq. (12) is an exact phase-domain identity. When a long time interval is normalized by a single average period, the approximation conditions of Section 3.3 must also be satisfied. Algebraic consistency must not be mistaken for exactness under an arbitrary time-domain model.

#6.5 亚稳态声明的合理边界

一位变化的 Gray/Johnson 状态可以限制数字码相邻性，但不会让该采样触发器不再具有模拟亚稳态风险。延迟匹配和双候选选择也依赖器件、布线、占空比及安全窗口。

本报告采用两层验收：在定义的数字延迟/边界模型中证明不存在静默错码；在晶体管与 PVT 模型中，另行评估亚稳态传播、决策延迟及剩余失效率。当前不把任何专利的功能描述当作本项目“任意相位、绝对零失败”的验证结果。

#6.5 Reasonable Boundaries for Metastability Claims

A Gray/Johnson state with single-bit changes can constrain the adjacency of the digital codes, but it does not free the sampling flip-flop from the risk of analog metastability. Delay matching and dual-candidate selection likewise depend on the devices, routing, duty cycle and safe window.

This report adopts two-level acceptance: within the defined digital delay/boundary model, prove that no silent wrong code exists; within transistor-level and PVT models, separately evaluate metastability propagation, decision delay and the residual failure rate. For now, the functional description in any patent is not taken as a verification result for this project's “arbitrary phase, absolutely zero failures”.

#7 核心难点二：snapshot 的三条实现路线与时序约束

#7 Core Difficulty 2: Three Implementation Routes for the Snapshot and Their Timing Constraints

#7.1 路线 A：多候选捕获与安全路径选择

思路是由 rising/falling 或多个相位生成不同参考重定时候选，分别捕获相位信息，再根据边界侧信息选择安全候选。TI 和 Kuo 提供相关直接实现；Havens/Marvell 展示额外状态判断的重要性。[R01][R06][R08][R10]

工程上要区分三件事：数据候选是否稳定、选择控制是否稳定、选择之后的整个元组是否来自同一候选。不能只让每个候选寄存器满足 setup/hold，却用一个可能晚到或亚稳的 select 去组合切换大总线。

建议以“候选元组”为选择单位：{coarse, low_state, boundary_side, fine_anchor_id, candidate_id}。选择后再输出有效事件，而不是 coarse 选 A、fine 默认为 B。

#7.1 Route A: Multi-Candidate Capture and Safe-Path Selection

The idea is to generate different reference-retiming candidates from the rising/falling edges or from multiple phases, capture the phase information with each candidate, and then select the safe candidate based on boundary-side information. TI and Kuo provide related direct implementations; Havens/Marvell show the importance of additional state judgments. [R01][R06][R08][R10]

In engineering terms, three things must be distinguished: whether the data candidates are stable, whether the selection control is stable, and whether the entire tuple after selection comes from the same candidate. It is not acceptable to have only each candidate register meet setup/hold while using a select signal that may arrive late or be metastable to combinationally switch a wide bus.

It is recommended to take the “candidate tuple” as the unit of selection: {coarse, low_state, boundary_side, fine_anchor_id, candidate_id}. A valid event is output only after selection, rather than coarse selecting A while fine defaults to B.

#7.2 路线 B：沿计数传播方向匹配采样时刻

设第 i 组数据对应目标逻辑边沿 tEt_EtE​，其传播延迟落在 [dimin,dimax][d_i^{min},d_i^{max}][dimin​,dimax​]；采样时间为 tS,it_{S,i}tS,i​。必要约束为：

tS,imin≥tE+dimax+tsu,i,(13)t_{S,i}^{min}\geq t_E+d_i^{max}+t_{su,i}, \tag{13}tS,imin​≥tE​+dimax​+tsu,i​,(13)
tS,imax+th,i≤tnext,i+dnext,imin.(14)t_{S,i}^{max}+t_{h,i}\leq t_{next,i}+d_{next,i}^{min}. \tag{14}tS,imax​+th,i​≤tnext,i​+dnext,imin​.(14)

这里 tnext,it_{next,i}tnext,i​ 是该组下一次可能改写的逻辑事件，未必每组都等于 tE+T0t_E+T_0tE​+T0​。更重要的是，所有组须针对同一个目标逻辑 epoch；把任意组都“等到稳定再采”并不能保证采到同一拍。

Zong Fig.9 的理想匹配提供了约半个 CKV 周期的相对读出位置。移植到本项目时应计算实际余量：

mi=tS,imin−tE−dimax−tsu,i,hi=tnext,i+dnext,imin−tS,imax−th,i.(15)m_i=t_{S,i}^{min}-t_E-d_i^{max}-t_{su,i},\quad h_i=t_{next,i}+d_{next,i}^{min}-t_{S,i}^{max}-t_{h,i}. \tag{15}mi​=tS,imin​−tE​−dimax​−tsu,i​,hi​=tnext,i​+dnext,imin​−tS,imax​−th,i​.(15)

验收条件是每组 mi>0,hi>0m_i>0,h_i>0mi​>0,hi​>0，且所有组属于同一 epoch。[R05][R11]

#7.2 Route B: Matching the Sampling Instants Along the Count-Propagation Direction

Let the data of group i correspond to the target logical edge tEt_EtE​, with its propagation delay lying in [dimin,dimax][d_i^{min},d_i^{max}][dimin​,dimax​], and let the sampling time be tS,it_{S,i}tS,i​. The necessary constraints are:

tS,imin≥tE+dimax+tsu,i,(13)t_{S,i}^{min}\geq t_E+d_i^{max}+t_{su,i}, \tag{13}tS,imin​≥tE​+dimax​+tsu,i​,(13)
tS,imax+th,i≤tnext,i+dnext,imin.(14)t_{S,i}^{max}+t_{h,i}\leq t_{next,i}+d_{next,i}^{min}. \tag{14}tS,imax​+th,i​≤tnext,i​+dnext,imin​.(14)

Here tnext,it_{next,i}tnext,i​ is the next logical event that may overwrite this group, and it is not necessarily equal to tE+T0t_E+T_0tE​+T0​ for every group. More importantly, all groups must target the same logical epoch; making every group “wait until it is stable before sampling” does not guarantee that the same beat is captured.

The ideal matching in Zong Fig.9 provides a relative readout position of about half a CKV cycle. When transplanting it to this project, the actual margins should be computed:

mi=tS,imin−tE−dimax−tsu,i,hi=tnext,i+dnext,imin−tS,imax−th,i.(15)m_i=t_{S,i}^{min}-t_E-d_i^{max}-t_{su,i},\quad h_i=t_{next,i}+d_{next,i}^{min}-t_{S,i}^{max}-t_{h,i}. \tag{15}mi​=tS,imin​−tE​−dimax​−tsu,i​,hi​=tnext,i​+dnext,imin​−tS,imax​−th,i​.(15)

The acceptance condition is mi>0,hi>0m_i>0,h_i>0mi​>0,hi​>0 for every group, with all groups belonging to the same epoch. [R05][R11]

#7.3 路线 C：有界错配与冗余校正

Havens/Sony 说明可以允许已知类型的 integer capture ambiguity，再从 fractional state 识别和修正。但必须先建立“所有可能错误状态”的集合，而不是先选一个 XOR 再期待它覆盖所有错误。[R07][R08]

对 /8 最低要求是分别列出：低位合法相邻变化、高位错一组、高低位撕裂、fine anchor 延迟一 raw cycle、phase-selector 绕回、同步器延迟超过假设范围。不同错误可能需要不同冗余信息和不同无效处理。

#7.3 Route C: Bounded Mismatch and Redundant Correction

Havens/Sony show that an integer capture ambiguity of a known type can be tolerated and then identified and corrected from the fractional state. But the set of “all possible error states” must be established first, rather than first choosing an XOR and then hoping it covers all errors. [R07][R08]

For /8, the minimum requirement is to list separately: legal adjacent changes of the low bits, a high-bit error of one group, high/low-bit tearing, the fine anchor being delayed by one raw cycle, phase-selector wrap-around, and synchronizer delay exceeding the assumed range. Different errors may require different redundant information and different invalidity handling.

#7.4 三条路线不能用一个模块名代替完整证明

路线 能直接解决的问题 仍须独立证明
多候选 避开特定边界附近的危险采样位置 select 稳定、元组原子选择、固定/变化延迟
匹配延迟 各计数位传播不同步 PVT min/max、同一逻辑 epoch、复位与采样脉冲宽度
冗余校正 有界、可辨识的 epoch 不一致 故障集合覆盖、修正单位、歧义时 INVALID

可组合这些方法，但组合后必须重新检查联合状态空间。不能把某文献的 safe retimer 与另一文献的 correction 直接相加，就认为所有边界自然闭合。

#7.4 For All Three Routes, a Module Name Cannot Replace a Complete Proof

Route Problem it can directly solve Still requires independent proof
Multi-candidate Avoids dangerous sampling positions near specific boundaries Select stability, atomic tuple selection, fixed/varying delays
Matched delay Count bits propagating non-simultaneously PVT min/max, the same logical epoch, reset and sampling-pulse width
Redundant correction Bounded, identifiable epoch inconsistencies Fault-set coverage, correction unit, INVALID on ambiguity

These methods can be combined, but after combination the joint state space must be re-checked. One cannot simply add one publication's safe retimer to another publication's correction and conclude that all boundaries are thereby closed.

#8 核心难点三：P/S 与物理边沿执行的因果性

#8 Core Difficulty 3: Causality of P/S and Physical Edge Execution

#8.1 P/S 的系统语义应是“执行指定边沿”

目标边沿编号分解为：

Jplan=MHJ+sJ,sJ∈{0,…,M−1}.(16)J_{\mathrm{plan}}=MH_J+s_J,\qquad s_J\in\{0,\ldots,M-1\}. \tag{16}Jplan​=MHJ​+sJ​,sJ​∈{0,…,M−1}.(16)

慢速域处理高位匹配、未来计划和并行控制；高速少量状态负责 slot / phase-local enable、脉冲形成及根时钟重定时。持续 CNT 仍独立记录实际经过的 CK0CK_0CK0​ 周期。

建议的功能数据流如下。它是本报告的架构综合，不是某篇原图的重绘。

实际 CK0 → 持续高/低计数状态 → REF 相关安全快照 → coarse anchor
                     │
计划 J_plan → 高位命中 + slot 控制 → 物理选沿/门控 → 实际边沿
                                                       │
                                            执行侧观察 J_observed
                                                       │
REF → 局部 fine 测量 ← 被选真实边沿 ──────────────────────┘
                     │
             元组一致性 + VALID/SAT + 坐标重建 → phase error

#8.1 The System Semantics of P/S Should Be “Execute a Designated Edge”

The target edge index is decomposed as:

Jplan=MHJ+sJ,sJ∈{0,…,M−1}.(16)J_{\mathrm{plan}}=MH_J+s_J,\qquad s_J\in\{0,\ldots,M-1\}. \tag{16}Jplan​=MHJ​+sJ​,sJ​∈{0,…,M−1}.(16)

The slow domain handles high-bit matching, future planning and parallel control; a small amount of high-speed state is responsible for slot / phase-local enable, pulse formation and root-clock retiming. The continuous CNT still independently records the CK0CK_0CK0​ cycles that have actually elapsed.

The recommended functional data flow is as follows. It is an architectural synthesis made in this report, not a redrawing of an original figure from any publication.

actual CK0 → continuous high/low count state → REF-related safe snapshot → coarse anchor
                     │
plan J_plan → high-bit hit + slot control → physical edge selection/gating → actual edge
                                                                                 │
                                                  execution-side observation J_observed
                                                                                 │
REF → local fine measurement ← selected true edge ───────────────────────────────┘
                     │
        tuple consistency + VALID/SAT + coordinate reconstruction → phase error

#8.2 不允许把计划当作已执行证据

必须区分 J_plan 与 J_observed。后者由实际执行路径、可信高速状态或边沿回执形成，不能把计划字延迟若干拍后改名为 J_exec。

原因是错沿、丢沿、重复沿和 gate control 晚到，可能完全不改变数字计划。若测量链只使用命令值，其重建相位在模型里看似正确，真实物理边沿却可能已经偏移一拍。

执行回执可以来自目标 slot 对应的稳定计数影子、受控的 launch acknowledgement 或匹配后状态；具体电路仍待确定。回执本身与实际输出之间的固定流水偏移也必须可追溯。

#8.2 The Plan Must Not Be Treated as Evidence of Execution

J_plan and J_observed must be distinguished. The latter is formed from the actual execution path, trustworthy high-speed state or an edge receipt; one must not delay the plan word by a few beats and rename it J_exec.

The reason is that a wrong edge, a missing edge, a duplicate edge or late gate control may leave the digital plan completely unchanged. If the measurement chain uses only the command value, its reconstructed phase may look correct in the model while the true physical edge has already shifted by one beat.

The execution receipt may come from a stable count shadow corresponding to the target slot, a controlled launch acknowledgement, or a post-matching state; the specific circuit is still to be determined. The fixed pipeline offset between the receipt itself and the actual output must also be traceable.

#8.3 后知后觉的低速 snapshot 不能生成已经过去的最近边沿

这是候选方案必须显式回答的因果性问题：REF 到来后，经过 snapshot、CDC、decode、低速计算再去控制 selector，REF 附近的某个 CKV 边沿可能早已过去。即使 q 算得完全正确，也不能倒退时间把那条边沿重新送入 TDC。

只有三类实现路径能闭合这一点：事先预测并在目标前提交选择；高速前端并行捕获候选/局部时间信息后再慢速解码；或者选用未来可执行边沿，并接受、校准其时间间隔及量程需求。

Kuo 的 time-predictive 选相属于具有先验规划的路线；不能把它理解为“参考到来后任意慢速算完，再无代价选择刚刚过去的最近相位”。[R06]

#8.3 An After-the-Fact Low-Speed Snapshot Cannot Generate a Nearest Edge That Has Already Passed

This is a causality question that any candidate scheme must answer explicitly: after REF arrives, by the time it has gone through snapshot, CDC, decode and low-speed computation and then controls the selector, a given CKV edge near REF may long since have passed. Even if q is computed perfectly correctly, time cannot be turned back to send that edge into the TDC again.

Only three classes of implementation paths can close this gap: predicting in advance and committing the selection before the target; having a high-speed front end capture candidate/local timing information in parallel and then decoding it at low speed; or choosing a future edge that can still be executed, and accepting and calibrating its time interval and range requirement.

Kuo's time-predictive phase selection belongs to the route with a priori planning; it must not be understood as “after the reference arrives, finish the computation at an arbitrarily slow pace and then select, at no cost, the nearest phase that has just passed”. [R06]

#8.4 选沿 deadline 与 late 策略

设选择控制必须在目标边沿前 tsetup,exect_{\mathrm{setup,exec}}tsetup,exec​ 建立，命令在执行器到达时刻为 tarrivet_{\mathrm{arrive}}tarrive​，则需要：

tarrive+tsetup,exec+tguard≤ttarget.(17)t_{\mathrm{arrive}}+t_{\mathrm{setup,exec}}+t_{\mathrm{guard}}\leq t_{\mathrm{target}}. \tag{17}tarrive​+tsetup,exec​+tguard​≤ttarget​.(17)

若不满足，不能悄悄在下一 slot 补发并仍返回原 edge ID。必须明确采用 LATE/MISS、重新规划一个不同的 J，或切换测量策略。任何补发都应改变执行回执及相位坐标。

对相邻事件，还要保证连续两个合法 pulse 不合并、不丢失、不重复。通用 PISO 输出连续“1”的电平行为，不一定等于需要的两个独立采样边沿。

#8.4 Edge-Selection Deadline and Late Policy

Suppose the selection control must be established tsetup,exect_{\mathrm{setup,exec}}tsetup,exec​ before the target edge, and the command arrives at the executor at time tarrivet_{\mathrm{arrive}}tarrive​; then it is required that:

tarrive+tsetup,exec+tguard≤ttarget.(17)t_{\mathrm{arrive}}+t_{\mathrm{setup,exec}}+t_{\mathrm{guard}}\leq t_{\mathrm{target}}. \tag{17}tarrive​+tsetup,exec​+tguard​≤ttarget​.(17)

If this is not satisfied, one must not silently reissue in the next slot while still returning the original edge ID. One must explicitly adopt LATE/MISS, re-plan a different J, or switch the measurement strategy. Any reissue should change the execution receipt and the phase coordinate.

For adjacent events, it must also be guaranteed that two consecutive legal pulses are not merged, lost or duplicated. The level behaviour of a generic PISO outputting consecutive “1”s is not necessarily the same as the two independent sampling edges that are required.

#8.5 MASH 属于扩展层，不是本次文献同构判断的偷换条件

前轮方案包含 MASH future edge。本次基础问题首先解决持续 CNT、/M residue、snapshot 与 selected-edge fine 的对应关系。MASH 只在这一接口上提供目标序列；它的阶数、状态范围、dither 和反馈预测误差还需另行量化。

不能因为某篇资料没有 MASH，就否定其对基础测量问题的直接贡献；也不能因为找到了 MASH 分频器，就认为原周期 CNT 与 fine 接口自然得到解决。

#8.5 MASH Belongs to the Extension Layer, Not a Condition Smuggled into This Round's Literature-Isomorphism Judgment

The previous-round scheme included a MASH future edge. The basic problem in this round is first to resolve the correspondence among the continuous CNT, the /M residue, the snapshot and the selected-edge fine measurement. MASH only supplies a target sequence on top of this interface; its order, state range, dither and feedback prediction error still need to be quantified separately.

One cannot deny a source's direct contribution to the basic measurement problem merely because it has no MASH; nor can one consider the raw-cycle CNT and fine interface to be naturally solved merely because a MASH divider has been found.

#9 核心难点四：fine 的真实量程、饱和与校准

#9 Core Difficulty 4: True Fine Range, Saturation and Calibration

#9.1 CNT 的大范围与 TDC 的物理小范围是两种职责

CNT 可以表示参考与当前状态之间的多周期差，保持锁定跟踪瞬态中的 coarse 观测；但它不改变两个 TDC 输入端之间已经存在的物理时间间隔。短 TDC 的量程必须通过实际选沿、捕获结构、预测或 DTC 等机制约束。[R06][R09][R11]

假设饱和函数 Q(x)Q(x)Q(x) 把所有 x≥Rx\geq Rx≥R 都输出 R，则 Q(1.5R)=Q(3R)=RQ(1.5R)=Q(3R)=RQ(1.5R)=Q(3R)=R。只知道这个输出不能恢复原输入。之后再减某个整数周期，也不能恢复已被压成同一码的 fine 信息。

因此，“数字可以做 modulo”不能证明“模拟 TDC 可以缩到一个周期”。前者是数值表示，后者是物理可观测性。

#9.1 The Large Range of the CNT and the Small Physical Range of the TDC Are Two Different Responsibilities

The CNT can represent a multi-cycle difference between the reference and the current state, and can maintain the coarse observation through lock-acquisition and tracking transients; but it does not change the physical time interval that already exists between the two TDC inputs. The range of a short TDC must be constrained by mechanisms such as actual edge selection, the capture structure, prediction or a DTC. [R06][R09][R11]

Suppose a saturation function Q(x)Q(x)Q(x) outputs R for all x≥Rx\geq Rx≥R; then Q(1.5R)=Q(3R)=RQ(1.5R)=Q(3R)=RQ(1.5R)=Q(3R)=R. Knowing only this output, the original input cannot be recovered. Subtracting some whole number of cycles afterwards cannot recover fine information that has already been compressed into the same code either.

Therefore “the digital side can take a modulo” does not prove that “the analog TDC can be shrunk to one cycle”. The former is a matter of numerical representation; the latter is a matter of physical observability.

#9.2 路径延迟、DTC 与归一化的符号

定义 TDC 引脚实际时间差：

dpin=(tE+τE)−(tR+τR).d_{\mathrm{pin}}=(t_E+\tau_E)-(t_R+\tau_R).dpin​=(tE​+τE​)−(tR​+τR​).

需要恢复的原事件间隔为：

Δt^=d^pin−(τ^E−τ^R).(18)\widehat{\Delta t}=\widehat d_{\mathrm{pin}}-(\widehat\tau_E-\widehat\tau_R). \tag{18}Δt=dpin​−(τE​−τR​).(18)

若 DTC 插在参考路径，其延迟计入 τR\tau_RτR​；若插在反馈路径，则计入 τE\tau_EτE​。必须统一使用式 (18) 的路径定义，不能一处把 DTC 当已补偿，另一处再次添加。

时间 LSB 归一化为：

μ^=(code−code0)LSBtT^0+ophase.(19)\widehat\mu=(\mathrm{code}-\mathrm{code}_0)\frac{\mathrm{LSB}_t}{\widehat T_0}+o_{\mathrm{phase}}. \tag{19}μ​=(code−code0​)T0​LSBt​​+ophase​.(19)

其中 ophaseo_{\mathrm{phase}}ophase​ 是剩余的校准相位偏置。LSB_t、code_0、选相/DCC偏差、差分路径延迟和周期估计需要携带校准版本。将 raw code 直接当作原周期小数，可能把增益或时钟节点差错隐藏在相位环路中。

#9.2 Path Delay, DTC and the Signs of Normalization

Define the actual time difference at the TDC pins:

dpin=(tE+τE)−(tR+τR).d_{\mathrm{pin}}=(t_E+\tau_E)-(t_R+\tau_R).dpin​=(tE​+τE​)−(tR​+τR​).

The original event interval to be recovered is:

Δt^=d^pin−(τ^E−τ^R).(18)\widehat{\Delta t}=\widehat d_{\mathrm{pin}}-(\widehat\tau_E-\widehat\tau_R). \tag{18}Δt=dpin​−(τE​−τR​).(18)

If the DTC is inserted in the reference path, its delay is counted in τR\tau_RτR​; if it is inserted in the feedback path, it is counted in τE\tau_EτE​. The path definition of Eq. (18) must be used uniformly; one cannot treat the DTC as already compensated in one place and then add it again in another.

The time-LSB normalization is:

μ^=(code−code0)LSBtT^0+ophase.(19)\widehat\mu=(\mathrm{code}-\mathrm{code}_0)\frac{\mathrm{LSB}_t}{\widehat T_0}+o_{\mathrm{phase}}. \tag{19}μ​=(code−code0​)T0​LSBt​​+ophase​.(19)

Here ophaseo_{\mathrm{phase}}ophase​ is the remaining calibrated phase offset. LSB_t, code_0, the phase-selection/DCC deviations, the differential path delays and the period estimate must carry a calibration version. Treating the raw code directly as a fraction of the raw cycle may hide gain errors or clock-node mistakes inside the phase loop.

#9.3 Fine 采用条件

建议：

Fusable=Vcode∧Vrange∧Vanchor∧Vepoch∧Vcal.(20)F_{\mathrm{usable}}=V_{\mathrm{code}}\land V_{\mathrm{range}}\land V_{\mathrm{anchor}} \land V_{\mathrm{epoch}}\land V_{\mathrm{cal}}. \tag{20}Fusable​=Vcode​∧Vrange​∧Vanchor​∧Vepoch​∧Vcal​.(20)

其中各 V 分别表示对应的有效性判据，FusableF_{\mathrm{usable}}Fusable​ 对应接口 fine_usable。range_ok 必须来自电路可实现的 saturate/overflow/窗口检查，而不是仿真器里不可见的理想真实相位。anchor_ok 则要求实际所选物理边沿与其编号一致。

一侧饱和可能仍保留“误差方向”信息。这种信息可以参与单独定义的限幅控制策略，如 Zong 的瞬态处理，但不能标记为精确的 fine residual。[R11]

#9.3 Conditions for Adopting the Fine Value

Recommended:

Fusable=Vcode∧Vrange∧Vanchor∧Vepoch∧Vcal.(20)F_{\mathrm{usable}}=V_{\mathrm{code}}\land V_{\mathrm{range}}\land V_{\mathrm{anchor}} \land V_{\mathrm{epoch}}\land V_{\mathrm{cal}}. \tag{20}Fusable​=Vcode​∧Vrange​∧Vanchor​∧Vepoch​∧Vcal​.(20)

Here each V denotes the corresponding validity criterion, and FusableF_{\mathrm{usable}}Fusable​ corresponds to the interface signal fine_usable. range_ok must come from saturate/overflow/window checks that the circuit can actually implement, not from an ideal true phase that is available in a simulator but invisible to the circuit. anchor_ok, in turn, requires that the physical edge actually selected be consistent with its index.

One-sided saturation may still retain “error direction” information. Such information can take part in a separately defined clamped control strategy, such as Zong's transient handling, but it must not be labelled as an exact fine residual. [R11]

#9.4 Coarse 接管不等于删除 fine，更不等于凭空加一个 FLL

当 fine 无效、coarse 仍可靠时，可以使用已定义的粗相位估计和量化误差上界；或保留符号/区间信息进入受控策略。若 coarse 也无法判定，则本次观测必须 invalid，而不是强行拼接。

以参考累加相位 R[k]R[k]R[k] 和 coarse 观测 NR[k]N_R[k]NR​[k] 为例：

ec[k]=R[k]−NR[k].(21)e_c[k]=R[k]-N_R[k]. \tag{21}ec​[k]=R[k]−NR​[k].(21)

这是量化较粗的相位误差。其差分才对应：

ec[k]−ec[k−1]=FCW[k]−(NR[k]−NR[k−1]).(22)e_c[k]-e_c[k-1]=FCW[k]-(N_R[k]-N_R[k-1]). \tag{22}ec​[k]−ec​[k−1]=FCW[k]−(NR​[k]−NR​[k−1]).(22)

所以 CNT 不天然意味着一条独立 FLL。只有另行设计频率误差控制器、状态机或增益路径时，才应称为 FLL-assisted 控制。

fine 恢复时还必须检查坐标偏置一致与控制状态连续，不能因 phase_source 切换引入人为整周期跳变。冻结积分、限幅积分或分阶段重新准入都属于需要闭环验证的策略，本文不预设已经优选完成。

#9.4 Coarse Takeover Does Not Mean Deleting Fine, Still Less Adding an FLL Out of Nowhere

When fine is invalid but coarse is still reliable, a defined coarse phase estimate together with its quantization-error upper bound may be used; or the sign/interval information may be retained and fed into a controlled strategy. If coarse cannot be determined either, this observation must be invalid, rather than being forcibly stitched together.

Take the reference accumulated phase R[k]R[k]R[k] and the coarse observation NR[k]N_R[k]NR​[k] as an example:

ec[k]=R[k]−NR[k].(21)e_c[k]=R[k]-N_R[k]. \tag{21}ec​[k]=R[k]−NR​[k].(21)

This is a coarsely quantized phase error. Only its difference corresponds to:

ec[k]−ec[k−1]=FCW[k]−(NR[k]−NR[k−1]).(22)e_c[k]-e_c[k-1]=FCW[k]-(N_R[k]-N_R[k-1]). \tag{22}ec​[k]−ec​[k−1]=FCW[k]−(NR​[k]−NR​[k−1]).(22)

So the CNT does not inherently imply an independent FLL. Only when a frequency-error controller, a state machine or a gain path is separately designed should it be called FLL-assisted control.

When fine recovers, the consistency of the coordinate offset and the continuity of the control state must also be checked; switching phase_source must not introduce an artificial whole-cycle jump. Freezing the integrator, clamping the integrator, or staged re-admission are all strategies that require closed-loop verification; this document does not presuppose that an optimal choice has already been made.

#9.5 一个说明量程的数值例子

以下是理想计算示例，不是芯片指标：原始 f0=8f_0=8f0​=8 GHz，则 T0=125T_0=125T0​=125 ps。/4 周期为 500 ps；均匀八相间距是 62.5 ps。若可选择最近相位，理想 signed residual 可在半个相位间距内；若必须选择后继相位，则最大等待接近一个相位间距。

在这两种理想范围之外，还要增加预测误差、相位不均匀、路径误差、瞬态频偏及判决 guard。即使“八相”存在，也不能不说明选沿因果性就直接把 TDC 量程写成 ±31.25 ps。范围必须由实际测量流程导出。

#9.5 A Numerical Example Illustrating the Range

The following is an idealized calculation example, not a chip specification: with a raw f0=8f_0=8f0​=8 GHz, T0=125T_0=125T0​=125 ps. The /4 period is 500 ps; the uniform eight-phase spacing is 62.5 ps. If the nearest phase can be selected, the ideal signed residual can be kept within half a phase spacing; if the succeeding phase must be selected, the maximum wait approaches one phase spacing.

Beyond these two ideal ranges, one must further add prediction error, phase non-uniformity, path error, transient frequency offset and the decision guard. Even if “eight phases” exist, one cannot write the TDC range directly as ±31.25 ps without explaining the causality of edge selection. The range must be derived from the actual measurement procedure.

#10 面向实现的事件接口与不变量

#10 Implementation-Oriented Event Interface and Invariants

#10.1 建议的 EventFrame

以下是接口建议，不是已发布 RTL。

字段组 建议字段 定义要点
事件身份 event_id, ref_kind, reset_epoch 区分本次参考、双沿类别及复位世代
计数坐标 clock_node_id, M, C_cap, q_cap 明确数的是哪个时钟节点；禁止无单位混接
捕获来源 candidate_id, capture_epoch, wrap_tag 指明候选及跨组状态；不能只保留数值
计划/执行 J_plan, J_observed, edge_polarity 实际回执独立于命令；极性影响细相位原点
修正 kappa_C, kappa_N, alpha_sel 分别为组单位、原周期单位、周期内偏移
Fine fine_raw, fine_valid, sat_hi, sat_lo 码值与可信性分离；饱和不等于精确残差
校准 tdc_gain_epoch, period_epoch, path_epoch fine 与 coarse 权重必须使用相容的校准
异常 late, miss, duplicate, encoding_invalid 执行错误不可被普通相位码掩盖
输出 phase_source, phase_value, uncertainty fine/coarse/invalid 及明确的误差上界或区间

原先的 {C,q,TDC}，以及后来增加 edge/correction 的四元组，都不足以完整表达上述执行、单位和有效性。接口不必把所有字段都实现为宽总线，但其语义必须有硬件对应。

#10.1 Proposed EventFrame

The following is an interface proposal, not published RTL.

Field group Proposed fields Key points of the definition
Event identity event_id, ref_kind, reset_epoch Distinguishes the current reference event, the dual-edge category and the reset generation
Count coordinates clock_node_id, M, C_cap, q_cap States explicitly which clock node is being counted; mixing quantities without units is forbidden
Capture source candidate_id, capture_epoch, wrap_tag Identifies the candidate and the group-boundary-crossing state; keeping only the numeric value is not enough
Plan/execution J_plan, J_observed, edge_polarity The actual receipt is independent of the command; the polarity affects the origin of the fine phase
Correction kappa_C, kappa_N, alpha_sel In group units, in raw-cycle units, and the intra-cycle offset, respectively
Fine fine_raw, fine_valid, sat_hi, sat_lo The code value and its trustworthiness are kept separate; saturation is not the same as an exact residual
Calibration tdc_gain_epoch, period_epoch, path_epoch The fine and coarse weights must use mutually compatible calibrations
Exceptions late, miss, duplicate, encoding_invalid Execution errors must not be masked by an ordinary phase code
Output phase_source, phase_value, uncertainty fine/coarse/invalid, plus an explicit error bound or interval

Neither the original {C,q,TDC} nor the later four-tuple that added edge/correction is sufficient to fully express the execution, units and validity described above. The interface need not implement every field as a wide bus, but its semantics must have a hardware counterpart.

#10.2 必须保持的不变量

编号 不变量 违反后的处理
I1 实际 CK0 周期连续，N=MC+qN=MC+qN=MC+q 的原点与 carry 一致 阻断有效相位；检查复位/极性/计数实现
I2 coarse 与 fine 同锚点，或显式记录锚点变换 校正或 INVALID，不静默相加
I3 correction 的单位和可覆盖错误集合明确 超界置无效；不截断成 ±1
I4 J_observed 反映真实执行，不由 J_plan 自证 标记回执未证实，不进入 fine_valid
I5 fine 量程、码合法性和校准全部满足 降级使用 coarse/区间/无效
I6 两种边界候选在共同坐标下等价 不一致视为 coarse/fine stitching 错误
I7 低速计算符合选沿 deadline late/miss 或重新规划并更新 J
I8 全 counter rollover 采用明确模运算窗口 超出可展开范围时 reset/reacquire

对 W-bit 总计数，模差转换为有符号差时，要保证期望差及采样间隔落在可唯一展开的窗口，典型条件是幅度小于 2W−12^{W-1}2W−1。这是一项计数宽度和观测间隔的联合约束，不是增加一个符号位就自动成立。

#10.2 Invariants That Must Be Maintained

No. Invariant Handling upon violation
I1 The actual CK0 cycles are continuous, and the origin of N=MC+qN=MC+qN=MC+q is consistent with the carry Block the valid phase; check the reset/polarity/counter implementation
I2 Coarse and fine share the same anchor, or the anchor transformation is explicitly recorded Correct, or INVALID; never add them silently
I3 The units of the correction and the set of errors it can cover are explicit Mark invalid when out of bounds; do not truncate to ±1
I4 J_observed reflects the real execution and is not self-certified by J_plan Mark the receipt as unverified; it does not enter fine_valid
I5 The fine range, code legality and calibration are all satisfied Downgrade to coarse / an interval / invalid
I6 The two boundary candidates are equivalent in a common coordinate Inconsistency is treated as a coarse/fine stitching error
I7 The low-speed computation meets the edge-selection deadline late/miss, or re-plan and update J
I8 Full-counter rollover uses an explicit modular-arithmetic window Reset/reacquire when beyond the range that can be unwrapped

For a W-bit total count, when a modular difference is converted into a signed difference, it must be guaranteed that the expected difference and the sampling interval fall within a window that can be uniquely unwrapped; the typical condition is that the magnitude is less than 2W−12^{W-1}2W−1. This is a joint constraint on the count width and the observation interval; it does not hold automatically just because a sign bit is added.

#10.3 相位整合的伪代码

on complete_event(frame):
    check_clock_node_and_reset_epoch(frame)
    coarse = decode_and_align_coarse(frame)
    observed = verify_physical_edge_identity(frame)

    if coarse.valid and observed.valid and fine_is_usable(frame):
        anchor = observed.J + frame.alpha_sel
        mu = normalize_fine_with_matching_calibration(frame)
        phase = anchor - mu
        return FINE, phase, fine_error_bound

    if coarse.valid:
        return COARSE, coarse.phase_estimate, coarse.error_bound

    return INVALID, no_new_measurement

这段伪代码刻意不指定 coarse controller 的增益和积分动作，因为测量有效性与控制器故障恢复不是同一问题。控制层必须对 COARSE/INVALID 有单独、可验证的状态处理。

#10.3 Pseudo-code for Phase Consolidation

on complete_event(frame):
    check_clock_node_and_reset_epoch(frame)
    coarse = decode_and_align_coarse(frame)
    observed = verify_physical_edge_identity(frame)

    if coarse.valid and observed.valid and fine_is_usable(frame):
        anchor = observed.J + frame.alpha_sel
        mu = normalize_fine_with_matching_calibration(frame)
        phase = anchor - mu
        return FINE, phase, fine_error_bound

    if coarse.valid:
        return COARSE, coarse.phase_estimate, coarse.error_bound

    return INVALID, no_new_measurement

This pseudo-code deliberately does not specify the gain or the integral action of the coarse controller, because measurement validity and controller fault recovery are not the same problem. The control layer must have separate, verifiable state handling for COARSE/INVALID.

#11 前几轮结论的修订与保留记录

前轮表述或倾向 本报告处理 原因
“/8 使 fine TDC 必然看到 8 个原周期，再由 snapshot 压回去” 不成立，必须逐节点核对 counter 降速、TDC 输入预分频与物理选沿是三件不同的事 [R01][R06][R11]
“Sony 才首次找到同状态参与整数与小数” 收紧为另一条直接实现 Havens 已有共享 half-rate state、fractional correction 和 sub-fractional TDC [R08]
“统一采用 κ=−1/0/+1” 改为带单位、带故障集合的修正 raw-cycle 与 block-cycle 不同；高低位撕裂可错 ±M
“8C+q+e/8+ϵ8C+q+e/8+\epsilon8C+q+e/8+ϵ 可作通用相位公式” 撤回通用性，改用锚点减残差 q/e 可能重复表示同一相位区间；e/8 的时钟单位未统一
“Kuo 原始 DCO 约 2 GHz，再 /4” 更正时钟层级 其 DCO 范围 5.7–8.4 GHz，约 2 GHz 是 /4 后量级 [R06]
“Zong /4 split 保留的是原始 20 GHz 全部周期” 不作此结论 Fig.9 的 counter 基准是前置 /8 后的 CKV [R11]
“相干必须等于同时锁存” 保留逻辑相干定义 匹配延迟读出可在不同时刻取得同一逻辑 epoch [R05][R11]
“所有边界必须复原唯一物理边沿” 改为一致候选或无效 不同锚点可以表示同一参考相位；不能把器件亚稳风险写成绝对保证
“数字整数相消即可删除 CNT” 明确不能这样推导 CNT 仍是真实 coarse 观测、回执校验与无效 fine 下的测量基础
“通用 PISO 是 CNT-ADPLL 直接先例” 维持前轮降级 只能证明执行器原语，不能证明粗细相位链完整 [R18]

此次整合不是抹去前轮成果：/4-/8 split、persistent CNT、边界校正、short TDC、selected-edge coordinate、SAT/VALID 及执行回执等主线均保留。修订的是证据范围、单位、时序假设和不能直接推广的结论。

#11 Record of Revisions to and Retentions of Previous Rounds' Conclusions

Previous-round statement or tendency Treatment in this report Reason
“/8 makes the fine TDC necessarily see 8 raw cycles, which the snapshot then folds back” Does not hold; must be checked node by node Counter rate reduction, pre-division of the TDC input and physical edge selection are three different things [R01][R06][R11]
“Sony was the first to have the same state take part in both the integer and the fractional part” Tightened to “another direct implementation” Havens already had a shared half-rate state, fractional correction and a sub-fractional TDC [R08]
“Uniformly adopt κ=−1/0/+1” Changed to a correction with units and with a fault set Raw-cycle and block-cycle differ; high/low-bit tearing can be wrong by ±M
“8C+q+e/8+ϵ8C+q+e/8+\epsilon8C+q+e/8+ϵ can serve as a general phase formula” Generality withdrawn; anchor minus residual used instead q and e may redundantly represent the same phase interval; the clock units of e/8 were not unified
“Kuo's raw DCO is about 2 GHz, then /4” Clock hierarchy corrected Its DCO range is 5.7–8.4 GHz; about 2 GHz is the order of magnitude after /4 [R06]
“Zong's /4 split preserves all cycles of the raw 20 GHz” This conclusion is not drawn The counter reference in Fig.9 is the CKV after the upstream /8 [R11]
“Coherence must equal simultaneous latching” The logical-coherence definition is retained Matched-delay readout can obtain the same logical epoch at different instants [R05][R11]
“Every boundary must recover the unique physical edge” Changed to “a consistent candidate, or invalid” Different anchors can represent the same reference phase; an absolute guarantee must not be claimed in the face of device metastability risk
“Digital integer cancellation is enough to delete the CNT” States explicitly that this cannot be inferred The CNT remains the real coarse observation, the receipt check and the measurement basis when fine is invalid
“A generic PISO is a direct precedent for the CNT-ADPLL” The previous round's downgrade is maintained It only proves the executor primitive, not that the coarse/fine phase chain is complete [R18]

This consolidation does not erase the previous rounds' results: the main lines — the /4-/8 split, the persistent CNT, boundary correction, the short TDC, the selected-edge coordinate, SAT/VALID and the execution receipt — are all retained. What is revised is the scope of the evidence, the units, the timing assumptions, and the conclusions that cannot be directly generalized.

#12.1 Performed: Six Groups of Logical/Dimensional Checks

In this round, the following checks were executed using exact rational arithmetic in Python. They serve to find errors at the formula and interface level; they do not cover RTL timing, metastability models, closed-loop noise, AMS or PVT.

Check Scope Cases Result
L01 Count decomposition M=4/8; N=0…4095 8192 Passed
L02 Group-boundary tearing M=4/8; 64 groups; two tearing modes 128 case sets Confirmed: ±M relative to the corresponding legal anchor

In total, 9860 well-defined logical cases. This count is not “9860 circuit simulations”; each L02 case checks two torn results internally, and the table follows the script's definition of a case count. The source code and the JSON results are included in the consolidation package.

#12.2 第一层：事件级 golden model

模型必须从原始真实边沿时间驱动持久 CNT，再分别模拟采样、执行和有限 TDC。禁止直接把理想 Φ0(tR)\Phi_0(t_R)Φ0​(tR​) 喂给 decoder 或用其生成电路不可获得的 VALID。

建议覆盖 /4、/8 全部 residue；跨组、全宽 rollover；rising/falling 候选切换；高位/低位不同传播延迟；fine 正负量程与饱和；选择码晚到；丢沿、重复沿、相邻脉冲；复位相位不同；固定路径延迟与校准版本错配。

验收输出不是只看 PLL 锁住，而是逐事件比较 J_observed、coarse anchor、最终 phase 与 ground truth，并统计每类故障能否被识别或被正确补偿。

#12.2 Layer 1: Event-Level Golden Model

The model must drive the persistent CNT from the raw, true edge times, and then separately model sampling, execution and the finite-range TDC. It is forbidden to feed the ideal Φ0(tR)\Phi_0(t_R)Φ0​(tR​) directly to the decoder, or to use it to generate a VALID that the circuit could not obtain.

Recommended coverage: all residues for /4 and /8; group-boundary crossing and full-width rollover; rising/falling candidate switching; different propagation delays for the high and low bits; the positive and negative fine range and saturation; late-arriving selection codes; missing edges, duplicate edges and adjacent pulses; different reset phases; fixed path delays and calibration-version mismatches.

The acceptance output is not just a check that the PLL locks; instead, J_observed, the coarse anchor and the final phase are compared with the ground truth event by event, and statistics are collected on whether each class of fault can be identified or correctly compensated.

#12.3 第二层：RTL/门级时序验证

重点检查 carry 极性、shift-state decode、候选元组选择、snapshot 生命周期、异步输入同步延迟、load/shift ownership、短脉冲、门控 latch 与根时钟 retiming。对每类异步路径给出明确的 STA/CDC 约束，而非简单全部 false-path。

最小输出应包含：每个事件的原边沿编号、C/q 原码、候选编号、边界标签、修正量及单位、J_plan/J_observed、fine_raw、VALID/SAT、最终相位和实际延迟。发现错误时应能回到同一编号的物理沿，而不是只回到一个时间戳日志行。

#12.3 Layer 2: RTL/Gate-Level Timing Verification

The key items to check are carry polarity, shift-state decode, candidate-tuple selection, snapshot lifetime, the synchronization latency of asynchronous inputs, load/shift ownership, short pulses, gating latches and root-clock retiming. Explicit STA/CDC constraints should be given for each class of asynchronous path, rather than simply declaring them all false paths.

The minimum output should include, for each event: the raw edge index, the raw C/q codes, the candidate ID, the boundary tag, the correction amount and its units, J_plan/J_observed, fine_raw, VALID/SAT, the final phase and the actual delay. When an error is found, it should be possible to trace it back to the physical edge with the same index, rather than only to a timestamped log line.

#12.4 第三层：晶体管/PVT 验证

必须补齐数字模型无法证明的部分：亚稳态解析时间、validity/selection 本身的亚稳传播、Johnson/Gray 非法码、delay-matching 失配、占空比、路径供电敏感度、mux/gate 毛刺、窄脉冲、TDC 饱和判定和回执电路的扰动。

本报告没有运行上述验证，也没有给出虚构的最差 PVT margin。第 7 章的参数化约束应转为实际电路的 min/max 表，而不是在未选工艺/负载前填写一个貌似确定的 ps 数值。

#12.4 Layer 3: Transistor/PVT Verification

This layer must fill in what a digital model cannot prove: metastability resolution time, metastability propagation in the validity/selection logic itself, illegal Johnson/Gray codes, delay-matching mismatch, duty cycle, the supply sensitivity of the paths, mux/gate glitches, narrow pulses, the TDC saturation decision, and disturbances to the receipt circuit.

This report has not run the above verification, nor does it give any fabricated worst-case PVT margin. The parameterized constraints of Chapter 7 should be converted into min/max tables for the actual circuit, rather than filling in a seemingly definitive ps value before the process/load has been chosen.

#12.5 闭环验证不能替代局部正确性

周期性 epoch 错误可能表现为 spur，偶发错组可能表现为长尾抖动或 cycle slip。PLL 能重新拉回并不意味着 detector 正确。因此顺序应为：事件身份正确 → 有效性完整 → 局部时序通过 → 再比较闭环噪声、spur、锁定时间与恢复时间。

需要记录相位误差峰值及分布、fine min/max/histogram、SAT 占比、修正触发分布、无效观测连续长度、edge mismatch 次数和模式切换的相位不连续。所有频谱测试还需注明采样率、相干窗口、长度和归一化单位。

#12.5 Closed-Loop Verification Cannot Replace Local Correctness

Periodic epoch errors may show up as spurs, and occasional wrong-group errors may show up as long-tail jitter or cycle slips. The fact that the PLL can pull itself back into lock does not mean that the detector is correct. The order should therefore be: correct event identity → complete validity → local timing passes → only then compare closed-loop noise, spurs, lock time and recovery time.

The following must be recorded: the peak and distribution of the phase error, the fine min/max/histogram, the SAT ratio, the distribution of correction triggers, the run lengths of consecutive invalid observations, the number of edge mismatches, and phase discontinuities at mode switches. All spectral tests must also state the sampling rate, the coherent window, the length and the normalization units.

#13 尚未闭合的核心问题与下一步研究清单

#13 Core Problems Not Yet Closed and the Next-Step Research List

#13.1 当前真正的文献空白

基础交集仍是：一个明确原始时钟节点的 /4 或 /8 split counter，低位 residue 直接关联 selected physical edge，short TDC 测量该边沿附近残差，并明确给出同一观测的 epoch/validity 机制。

公开资料已经分别支持组成环节，有些资料覆盖其中多项。尚缺的是把所有连接、编码和时序在一份可核验的实现中同时闭合；不能用“行业常用”补足空白。

#13.1 The Real Gap in the Current Literature

The basic intersection is still: a /4 or /8 split counter on an explicitly identified raw clock node, whose low residue is directly linked to the selected physical edge, with a short TDC measuring the residual near that edge, and with an explicitly specified epoch/validity mechanism for the same observation.

Public sources already support the constituent links separately, and some of them cover several of these links. What is still missing is closing all of the connections, encodings and timing simultaneously in a single verifiable implementation; the gap cannot be filled by appealing to “common industry practice”.

#13.2 必须先回答的五个工程问题

问题 必须形成的具体产物 完成判据
Q1：到底以哪个节点作为原周期？ clock-node 表与全部倍率/相位原点 CNT、FCW、TDC、DTC、edge ID 同一量纲
Q2：C/q 在边界如何关联？ 全 residue、wrap、候选切换真值表 每个允许状态都对应合法锚点或 INVALID
Q3：低位如何控制真实选沿？ raw-state→slot→physical-edge 映射及 deadline 不能生成过去边沿；late/miss 行为确定
Q4：谁证明实际边沿编号？ J_observed 电路与独立校验路径 计划错误/丢沿注入后不会自证通过
Q5：short TDC 何时可信？ 物理量程预算、SAT/VALID、校准/降级规范 饱和码不作为精确 fine，coarse 仍可解释

#13.2 Five Engineering Questions That Must Be Answered First

Question Concrete deliverable that must be produced Completion criterion
Q1: Which node exactly serves as the raw cycle? Clock-node table with all ratios/phase origins CNT, FCW, TDC, DTC and edge ID in the same units
Q2: How are C and q related at the boundary? Truth table covering all residues, wraps and candidate switches Every permitted state corresponds to a legal anchor or INVALID
Q3: How do the low bits control the real edge selection? raw-state→slot→physical-edge mapping and deadline No past edge can be generated; late/miss behaviour is deterministic
Q4: Who proves the actual edge index? J_observed circuit and an independent check path After injection of plan errors/missing edges, it does not self-certify as passing
Q5: When can the short TDC be trusted? Physical range budget, SAT/VALID, calibration/downgrade specification Saturated codes are not used as an exact fine value; coarse remains interpretable

#13.3 调研的收敛顺序

首先完成 TI / Xu / ETRI 的 carry、极性和解码关系；随后把 Havens/Sony 的冗余状态迁移为带明确错误集合的 /4-/8 epoch 表。第三步检查 Kuo/MediaTek 所使用的物理选相是否满足本项目执行因果性，而不是只看同样有一个 MUX。最后再接 MASH、DTC/QNC、REF X2 等扩展，并保留原始基线回归。

Jiang、Yin 和 Bogdan 原书仍是值得补齐原始页的历史线索；H. Liu 2025 的 counter/feedback-generator 内部图是另一个优先补证项。这些任务是本报告的后续研究清单，不代表已经安排自动后台执行。

#13.3 Order of Convergence for the Research

First, complete the carry, polarity and decoding relationships of TI / Xu / ETRI; then migrate the redundant state of Havens/Sony into a /4-/8 epoch table with an explicit error set. Third, check whether the physical phase selection used by Kuo/MediaTek satisfies this project's execution causality, rather than merely noting that it likewise contains a MUX. Finally, attach extensions such as MASH, DTC/QNC and REF X2, while retaining regression against the original baseline.

Jiang, Yin and the original Bogdan book remain historical leads whose original pages are worth retrieving; the internal counter/feedback-generator figures of H. Liu 2025 are another priority item for supplementary evidence. These tasks constitute the follow-up research list of this report and do not mean that automatic background execution has already been arranged.

#13.4 关于差异点的表述

“低位状态同时服务整数与小数”本身已有相关公开披露，不能仅以这句话概括潜在差异。更具体的研究对象应是：原周期 residue 的映射、实际选沿回执、block/raw-cycle 两级修正、有限 TDC 的有效性及恢复协议。

是否构成可保护的差异，仍需逐项对照专利权利要求、实施例和更完整的先前技术；本报告只提供技术证据与缺口，不给出新颖性、侵权或可授权结论。

#13.4 On How to State the Points of Difference

“The low-bit state serves both the integer and the fractional part” has in itself already been publicly disclosed in related work, so this sentence alone cannot be used to summarize a potential difference. The more specific objects of study should be: the mapping of the raw-cycle residue, the receipt for the actual edge selection, the two-level block/raw-cycle correction, and the validity and recovery protocol of the finite-range TDC.

Whether this constitutes a protectable difference still requires an item-by-item comparison against patent claims, embodiments and more complete prior art; this report only provides technical evidence and gaps, and does not give any conclusion on novelty, infringement or patentability.
